prs.title: fix(core): ask DashScope to stream tool-call arguments
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Tool-enabled streaming requests to the Model Studio OpenAI-compatible API now default to `tool_stream: true` for the qwen4-max, qwen3.8-max, qwen3.8-flash, and qwen3.7-plus families. Without it, Qwen models on DashScope hold back a tool argument whose schema declares an object or array (a findings list, a todo list, an MCP tool's array parameter) until the whole value is complete, and send nothing meanwhile. With it, the same argument arrives piece by piece. An explicit `generationConfig.samplingParams.tool_stream` reaches the wire, with `extra_body.tool_stream` taking final precedence.

## Why it's needed

A long buffered argument outlasts the 240 s stream idle timeout. qwen3.8-max asked for a 500-item array argument (about 59 KB) went silent for 268 s and then sent it in one chunk; the client aborts at 240 s and the retry stalls the same way (#18242 limits that to one retry and explains it in the error). With `tool_stream: true` the same request sent the argument in 4036 chunks, the longest gap 1.0 s. The silence grows with the argument: about 220 characters per second on qwen3.8-max, so a few dozen kilobytes is enough.

Arguments under a bare `{"type": "object"}` parameter are not held back; deferred tools called through `tool_call` already stream theirs (measured: 2483 argument chunks, longest gap 1.0 s, without `tool_stream`).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- In a streaming turn that offers tools on a supported Model Studio route, inspect the request body for `"tool_stream": true`. A forwarded model on a workspace endpoint, a non-streaming request, and a request without tools omit the default.
- Set `model.generationConfig.samplingParams.tool_stream: false` and confirm the request sends `false`. Set `extra_body.tool_stream: false` with sampling set to `true` and confirm `false` takes precedence.
- Against DashScope directly, a tool whose schema declares an array parameter, asked for a few hundred items, returns the argument in many small chunks instead of one large chunk after a long silence.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Raw streaming requests to DashScope, chunk times recorded:

| qwen3.8-max, Standard Beijing, 500-item array argument | Longest silence | Argument chunks |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Without `tool_stream` | 268 s | 5 |
| With `tool_stream: true` | 1.0 s | 4036 |

The same comparison with 30 items on each model:

| Model | Endpoints | Argument chunks without → with |
| --- | --- | --- |
| qwen4-max, qwen3.8-max, qwen3.8-flash, qwen3.7-plus | Standard Beijing; qwen3.8-max and qwen3.7-plus also Standard Singapore; qwen3.7-plus and qwen3.8-flash also Token Plan | 5–6 → 150–270 |
| deepseek-v4.1-flash, kimi-k3, glm-5.3 | Standard Beijing | already streamed; field accepted, no change |

Through the built CLI against DashScope, the logged requests carry `tool_stream: true` and the turn completes. The released CLI's run with the same task did not time out either, because that turn reached the tool through `tool_call`, whose arguments are not held back.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Built CLI against Bailian Standard (Beijing, Singapore) and Token Plan; raw replays with a stdlib script.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff — a model that gets stuck inside an argument can keep emitting deltas until `max_tokens` or the stream lifetime cap. The default 15-minute cap applies to each attempt. If every attempt reaches the cap with an argument still open, the generic retry budget can spend up to 45 minutes of upstream wait on the replay path (3 attempts) or 60 minutes on the continuation path (4 attempts). Normal streams that exceed the lifetime cap are also cut. The cap is addressed separately.
- Not validated / out of scope: Qwen OAuth, the DashScope Anthropic-compatible endpoint, internal DashScope-compatible gateways, the Coding Plan endpoint and other providers that buffer arguments; macOS and Windows.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Related: #18242.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

通过百炼 OpenAI 兼容接口发起带工具的流式请求时，qwen4-max、qwen3.8-max、qwen3.8-flash 和 qwen3.7-plus 系列会默认发送 `tool_stream: true`。不发时，DashScope 上的 Qwen 模型会把 schema 里声明为对象或数组的工具参数（发现列表、待办列表、MCP 工具的数组参数）扣到整个值生成完才发，期间什么都不发。发了以后，同样的参数会逐段到达。用户显式配置的 `generationConfig.samplingParams.tool_stream` 会透传，`extra_body.tool_stream` 优先级最高。

## 为什么需要

被扣住的长参数会超过 240 秒的流式空闲超时。让 qwen3.8-max 生成一个 500 项的数组参数（约 59 KB），它静默了 268 秒后才一次性发出；客户端在 240 秒时就会中止，重试也会同样卡住（#18242 把它限制为重试一次，并在报错中说明）。打开 `tool_stream: true` 后，同一个请求的参数分 4036 块到达，最长间隔 1.0 秒。静默时长随参数大小增长：qwen3.8-max 约每秒 220 个字符，所以几十 KB 就足够触发。

类型为裸 `{"type": "object"}` 的参数不会被扣住；通过 `tool_call` 调用的延迟加载工具本来就是逐段发参数的（实测不开 `tool_stream` 时 2483 块，最长间隔 1.0 秒）。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 在支持的百炼路由上发起带工具的流式请求，检查请求体是否包含 `"tool_stream": true`。在工作空间接入点使用转发模型、发起非流式请求或省略工具时，检查默认字段是否省略。
- 设置 `model.generationConfig.samplingParams.tool_stream: false`，确认请求发送 `false`。再把采样配置改为 `true` 并设置 `extra_body.tool_stream: false`，确认请求以 `false` 为准。
- 直接请求 DashScope，让一个 schema 声明了数组参数的工具生成几百项，参数会分成许多小块到达，而不是长时间静默后一次性到达。

### 证据（修改前后）

直接向 DashScope 发流式请求并记录每个 chunk 的时间：

| qwen3.8-max，标准版北京，500 项数组参数 | 最长静默 | 参数分块数 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 不带 `tool_stream` | 268 秒 | 5 |
| 带 `tool_stream: true` | 1.0 秒 | 4036 |

每个模型用 30 项做同样的对比：

| 模型 | 接入点 | 参数分块数：不带 → 带 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| qwen4-max、qwen3.8-max、qwen3.8-flash、qwen3.7-plus | 标准版北京；qwen3.8-max 和 qwen3.7-plus 另测标准版新加坡；qwen3.7-plus 和 qwen3.8-flash 另测 Token Plan | 5–6 → 150–270 |
| deepseek-v4.1-flash、kimi-k3、glm-5.3 | 标准版北京 | 本来就逐段发；接受该字段，无变化 |

通过构建好的 CLI 对接 DashScope，记录的请求都带有 `tool_stream: true`，回合正常完成。已发布的 CLI 跑同样的任务也没有超时，因为那个回合是通过 `tool_call` 调用工具的，其参数不会被扣住。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

已构建的 CLI 对接百炼标准版（北京、新加坡）和 Token Plan；用标准库脚本直接重放请求。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍是生成工具参数时发生失控，分块可能一直输出到 `max_tokens` 或流总时长上限。默认 15 分钟按单次尝试计算。若每次都在工具参数未完成时触及上限，通用重试预算下的重放路径最多累计等待上游 45 分钟（3 次尝试），续写路径为 60 分钟（4 次尝试）。正常输出超过流总时长上限也会被截断。上限另行处理。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：Qwen OAuth、DashScope 的 Anthropic 兼容接口、内部 DashScope 兼容网关、Coding Plan 接口，以及其他会扣住参数的供应商；macOS 和 Windows。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

相关：#18242。

</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): confine selected Hosted Workspace Shell
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an opt-in foreground Shell profile for built-in Hosted Agent Sessions bound to the root of a registered Workspace on durable, Session-exclusive Linux local Runtimes. Bubblewrap gives each command a read-only private image, the selected Workspace at `/workspace`, private temporary storage, and closed networking. The Broker and worker reject unsupported tools or contexts with typed errors. Failed confinement qualification blocks execution.

The Broker persists the original Runtime's cgroup v2 identity before the worker can run tools. Normal handback checks that the worker closed the Session's execution gates and is the original cgroup's sole member. Terminal drain can stop the original cgroup after the worker dies and clears Workspace ownership only after it records matching stop evidence.

## Why it's needed

The existing Bubblewrap profile permits some reads from the host filesystem. Proving that a worker PID exited also leaves open whether its descendants can still write to the Workspace. Hosted needs a private execution boundary and a stop proof the Broker can verify independently, so it can safely return Workspace ownership after a worker failure.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Configure `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provider-options.private-rootfs` with a trusted read-only image containing `/bin/sh` and set `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provider-options.cgroup-root` to a dedicated, writable cgroup v2 delegation. Use an unprivileged service account, a durable Session-exclusive Linux local Runtime, and verified Workspace storage. Confirm that a new root-bound Session advertises foreground Shell only and that two successive Shell turns can each release their Workspace claim.
2. Confirm that Shell can write its own Workspace and cannot see a host sentinel. Try a subdirectory Session and verify `managed_runtime_confinement_denied`. With confinement enabled, verify that an existing ordinary Session on a covered local placement can complete cleanup and is refused new Runtime work.
3. Kill the original worker while a test-owned process remains in its cgroup. Verify that early handback retains ownership, then close the Session. The Broker should stop the remaining process, persist a receipt for the original cgroup, and clear the holder. Check that a same-name replacement cgroup supplies neither stop authority nor stop evidence.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before, the earlier Linux qualification run confirmed that the existing Bubblewrap adapter could read a test-owned sentinel outside the Workspace. The private-root adapter blocked access to that sentinel and the sibling Workspace, and the fixture observed closed networking.
- After, the public Hosted Linux test completed two Shell turns, rejected a subdirectory Session, and closed the Session after stopping the original cgroup with the worker already gone. Maven reported one passing Hosted end-to-end case and three passing Linux cgroup regression cases, including replacement-identity refusal. The Hosted test reactor reported zero Checkstyle violations.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Linux ARM64 with Node.js 22, Temurin JDK 21, Bubblewrap 0.8.0, delegated cgroup v2, and MySQL 8.4.11. The public API test ran a real Broker, packaged Harness and worker, with a fixture model. On macOS ARM64, the repository build, typecheck, bundle and scoped lint passed, and focused Vitest runs reported 1,888 passes and 14 platform skips.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff** Missing or conflicting stop evidence keeps the Workspace holder in place. An already LOST binding with a populated cgroup requires operator recovery before ownership can be released.
- **Not validated / out of scope** Full CI and cold recovery after removing the opt-in settings were outside the final local run. The confined profile is limited to foreground Shell. Native file tools, MCP, hooks, executable extensions, and background processes remain outside this profile.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes** Confinement is off by default. Drain affected local leases before enabling it or changing the image. Existing ordinary Sessions on covered placements can complete cleanup and cannot start new Runtime work while confinement is enabled. The shared V1 baseline now indexes version-3 local recovery candidates. Recreate earlier development catalogs under the existing V1 policy.
- **Design documents** Private root [English](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/2cccc3c85497c756fd03762e01985642dc5ff42d/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-managed-private-root-bwrap.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/2cccc3c85497c756fd03762e01985642dc5ff42d/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-managed-private-root-bwrap.zh-CN.md), stop proof [English](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/2cccc3c85497c756fd03762e01985642dc5ff42d/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-managed-local-cgroup-stop-proof.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/2cccc3c85497c756fd03762e01985642dc5ff42d/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-managed-local-cgroup-stop-proof.zh-CN.md), Hosted integration [简体中文](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/2cccc3c85497c756fd03762e01985642dc5ff42d/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-managed-hosted-confinement.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #15081, #14667, and #12380.

---


<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

新增显式启用的 Hosted 前台 Shell 档案，适用于绑定到已注册 Workspace 根目录的内置 Agent Session，要求 Linux 本地 Runtime 支持持久化并由 Session 独占。Bubblewrap 为每条命令提供只读私有镜像、挂载到 `/workspace` 的选定 Workspace、私有临时目录和关闭的网络。Broker 与 Worker 对不支持的工具或上下文返回类型化错误。隔离资格校验失败时拒绝执行。

Broker 在 Worker 获准执行工具前，持久化原 Runtime 的 cgroup v2 身份。正常交还会验证 Worker 已关闭该 Session 的执行准入，且原 cgroup 中只剩原 Worker。Worker 死亡后，终态排空仍可停止原 cgroup，Broker 在记录匹配的停止证据后才释放 Workspace 所有权。

## Why it's needed

现有 Bubblewrap 档案允许读取部分宿主文件。仅证明 Worker PID 已退出，仍无法确定它的后代是否可以继续写入 Workspace。Hosted 需要私有执行边界和 Broker 可独立验证的停止证明，才能在 Worker 故障后安全交还 Workspace 所有权。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. 将 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provider-options.private-rootfs` 设置为包含 `/bin/sh` 的受信只读镜像，将 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.provider-options.cgroup-root` 设置为专用、可写的 cgroup v2 委派目录。使用非特权服务账号、持久化且由 Session 独占的 Linux 本地 Runtime，以及身份经过验证的 Workspace 存储。确认新的根目录 Session 只声明前台 Shell，连续两个 Shell 回合各自都能交还 Workspace 占用。
2. 确认 Shell 可以写入自己的 Workspace，且无法看到宿主哨兵文件。尝试创建绑定到子目录的 Session，确认收到 `managed_runtime_confinement_denied`。启用隔离后，验证受覆盖位置上的已有普通 Session 能完成清理，并被拒绝发起新的 Runtime 工作。
3. 在原 cgroup 内保留一个测试进程，然后杀掉原 Worker。确认提前交还仍保留所有权，再关闭 Session。Broker 应停止剩余进程，为原 cgroup 持久化回执，并清除 holder。检查同名替换 cgroup 既无法作为停止操作的授权目标，也不能作为停止证据。

### Evidence (Before & After)

- 变更前，早期 Linux 资格测试确认现有 Bubblewrap 适配器能读取 Workspace 之外的测试哨兵文件。私有根适配器阻断了对该文件和相邻 Workspace 的访问，测试也确认网络关闭。
- 变更后，公开 Hosted API 的 Linux 测试完成两个 Shell 回合，拒绝了子目录 Session，并在 Worker 已死亡的情况下停止原 cgroup、关闭 Session。Maven 报告 1 项 Hosted 端到端用例和 3 项 Linux cgroup 回归通过，包括拒绝替换身份的用例。Hosted 测试的 Maven reactor 报告 Checkstyle 零违规。

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Linux ARM64、Node.js 22、Temurin JDK 21、Bubblewrap 0.8.0、委派的 cgroup v2 和 MySQL 8.4.11。公开 API 测试使用真实 Broker、打包后的 Harness 与 Worker，并使用测试模型桩。在 macOS ARM64 上，仓库构建、类型检查、打包和针对性 lint 均通过。针对性的 Vitest 共通过 1,888 项，另有 14 项因平台条件跳过。

## Risk & Scope

- **主要风险或取舍** 停止证据缺失或冲突时保留 Workspace holder。已处于 LOST 状态且 cgroup 仍有进程的绑定，需要先经过运维恢复才能释放所有权。
- **未验证或不在范围内** 最终本地验证未覆盖全量 CI 或移除启用配置后的冷恢复。隔离档案仅支持前台 Shell。原生文件工具、MCP、Hook、可执行扩展和后台进程均不在此档案范围内。
- **不兼容变更与迁移说明** 隔离默认关闭。启用隔离或更换镜像前，先排空受影响的本地租约。启用期间，受覆盖位置上的已有普通 Session 可完成清理，新的 Runtime 工作会被拒绝。共享 V1 基线已将版本 3 本地 Runtime 纳入恢复候选索引，按现有 V1 策略重建早期开发库。
- **设计文档** 私有根 [English](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/2cccc3c85497c756fd03762e01985642dc5ff42d/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-managed-private-root-bwrap.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/2cccc3c85497c756fd03762e01985642dc5ff42d/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-managed-private-root-bwrap.zh-CN.md)，停止证明 [English](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/2cccc3c85497c756fd03762e01985642dc5ff42d/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-managed-local-cgroup-stop-proof.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/2cccc3c85497c756fd03762e01985642dc5ff42d/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-managed-local-cgroup-stop-proof.zh-CN.md)，Hosted 接入 [简体中文](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/2cccc3c85497c756fd03762e01985642dc5ff42d/docs/design/managed-agents/2026-11-21-managed-hosted-confinement.zh-CN.md)。

## Linked Issues

prs.title: fix(mcp): repair the MCP connection torn down by an aborted tool call
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Aborting an in-flight MCP request can tear the transport down: the SDK's `onerror` fires and the server flips to `DISCONNECTED`. The abort path used to return early without repairing anything, so a session that survived the cancel kept a dead connection. The abort path now arms a status listener and rethrows immediately; when the server actually reports the teardown, the listener reconnects and reloads the tool registry once, best-effort. The cancelled call is still never replayed.

## Why it's needed

Without the repair, every later MCP call in a session that survives the cancel inherited the dead connection: roughly 90s until the health monitor's `30s × 3` budget expired, and indefinitely when the client had already left the manager's `clients` map.

The repair cannot read the status inside the abort catch. The transport reports the failure only after the server reacts to `notifications/cancelled`, one round trip after the local rejection, so a status read there always sees `CONNECTED`. Keying the repair to the `CONNECTED → DISCONNECTED` transition through the existing `mcp-status` registry replaces that race rather than re-timing it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Unit level only: run the file below and confirm the three cases — an abort whose server then reports `DISCONNECTED` reconnects exactly once and does not re-issue the cancelled call, an abort whose server stays `CONNECTED` arms no repair, and a call that is not aborted still takes the existing cannot-safely-replay path.

A live-server run is what would settle the ordering claim, and it has not been done. Pool mode (`McpClientManager` pool entries, which run their own status listener before this one) has also not been driven.

```sh
# from packages/core
npx vitest run src/tools/mcp-tool.test.ts
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Added a regression test: an abort followed by the server reporting `DISCONNECTED` reconnects once and does not re-issue the cancelled call.
- Added the counterpart: an abort whose server stays `CONNECTED` performs no repair and leaves no listener behind.
- Updated `does not classify a parent abort wrapped by the MCP SDK as a timeout`, which pinned "abort ⇒ no MCP work at all" and so conflated "do not replay" with "do not repair". It now asserts the repair happens once and `callTool` still runs once. The timeout classification it guards is unchanged.
- The shared `expectNoRetry` helper keeps its `ensureTool` assertion: its default signal is never aborted, so the new branch is unreachable from either call site.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only; no dev server or sandbox.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the repair fires on any `CONNECTED → DISCONNECTED` for that server within 60s of an abort, so it cannot by itself tell a teardown the abort caused from one that happened nearby, and it carries no liveness check. Duplicate repairs from concurrent cancels collapse because `discoverMcpToolsForServer` already coalesces discovery per server. #12161, open on the same issue, is about `onerror` writing `DISCONNECTED` for sessions that may still answer a ping; if that lands, this trigger inherits its false positives, which cost one bounded, coalesced rediscovery.
- Not validated / out of scope: not reproduced end-to-end against a live HTTP/streamable MCP server; the ordering claim is source-derived and unit-covered only. Pool mode has not been driven. Not run: full `npm run build`, and the full repository test suite.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

### Local checks run

- `npx vitest run src/tools/mcp-tool.test.ts` — 187 passed (whole file, not just the changed tests).
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` in `packages/core` — clean.
- `npx eslint` on the two changed files — clean.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12160

prs.title: feat(web-shell): clear final 16 managed-host daemon imports and add CI zero-daemon bundle guard (slice 6c)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR completes Slice 6c, the final slice of the unified chat surface roadmap, by eliminating the last sixteen transitive daemon value-import edges from the managed host entry point (burning the full roadmap down from forty-seven edges to zero), removing the transitional ratchet allowlist from the AST boundary guard, and adding a zero-daemon runtime bundle gate to the managed-host CI workflow.

- **Pure leaf utility and error-guard decoupling (4 edges removed):** Imports hook execution summarization directly from the browser-safe shared core subpath, keeps the goal-status sentinel prefix local with an SDK parity check, extracts a browser-safe background-turn parser verified clause-by-clause against the daemon SDK, and replaces concrete daemon HTTP error class checks in artifact utilities with a daemon-error-named structural check verified against the daemon SDK.
- **Browser notification settings context split (1 edge removed):** Extracts the browser notification settings context and read hook into a daemon-free module re-exported by the existing notification provider so the approval card's notification help control no longer pulls daemon notification context transitively.
- **Daemon transcript viewport split (5 edges removed):** Moves the daemon history-navigation and message-deletion viewport implementation verbatim into a dedicated daemon viewport component while keeping the shared transcript viewport pure and accepting an optional host-injected session viewport component supplied by the main application column and split chat pane.
- **Daemon status-card renderers context (4 edges removed):** Introduces a backend-neutral status-card renderer context with daemon MCP and tasks status cards bound in a dedicated daemon module provided by the main application shell, split chat pane, and standalone transcript viewer while keeping both the headless workspace provider and shared system message component free of daemon status-card imports.
- **Shared workspace runtime context (2 edges removed):** Shares a module-scoped neutral workspace runtime context inside the daemon workspace provider and extracts the workspace artifact-target resolution hook verbatim with optional runtime support so shared turn outputs and tool file preview buttons degrade safely without a daemon workspace provider while existing daemon callers remain unchanged.
- **Zero-daemon boundary and CI bundle gate:** Deletes the transitional managed-host daemon edge allowlist from the AST boundary test to assert exact zero daemon edges and zero unresolved specifiers, and adds eight live-verified minified daemon runtime marker checks to the managed-host CI workflow plus its workflow meta-test.

## Why it's needed

After Slice 6a (47 to 31 edges) and Slice 6b (31 to 16 edges), sixteen transitive daemon value-import edges still entered the managed host dependency graph through transcript history, message deletion, notification settings, status sub-cards, and workspace file preview helpers, and the managed-host CI lane only asserted positive bundle markers rather than rejecting leaked daemon runtime code. Clearing these final sixteen edges and deleting the transitional allowlist enforces true zero-daemon isolation for the managed host at both the source AST level and the emitted bundle artifact level, closing out the unified chat surface isolation work.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run the AST boundary guard test suite and confirm zero daemon imports and zero backend-kind accesses across the chat core, zero unresolved specifiers, and exactly zero transitive daemon value-import edges from the managed host entry point with the transitional allowlist removed.
2. Run the workflow meta-test and all affected web-shell unit test suites (covering background-turn and artifact HTTP error parity, goal-status prefix parity, hook statistics, system message and status-card injection, browser notification control, tool file preview, turn outputs, transcript viewport and split pane, workspace provider context sharing, managed sessions page, build artifacts, and main application wiring), confirming all pass and shared components fail closed cleanly without daemon providers.
3. Run the full-repository TypeScript typecheck (including integration test module resolution), both web-shell and managed-host builds, ESLint, and Prettier, and run the workflow's eight negative runtime marker checks against the emitted managed-host output directory confirming zero leaks.
4. Run the checked-in Playwright Chromium end-to-end suites for split persistence, session scheduled tasks, managed attachments, and managed local files, confirming identical behavior on daemon and managed surfaces with zero console or page errors.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-user-visible internal module decoupling and CI bundle gate; daemon, managed, and static transcript surfaces retain identical UI and runtime behavior).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local macOS development environment: Vitest (23 affected web-shell test suites / 1,237 tests passed, including the zero-edge AST boundary guard and 47 build-artifact checks; main-shell wiring tests 2/2 passed; workflow meta-test 11/11 passed), web-shell and managed-host production builds with local replay of the eight CI negative bundle marker checks (zero daemon markers), ESLint (`--max-warnings=0`), Prettier check, full-repository `npm run typecheck` (including integration-tests `nodenext` resolution), and checked-in Playwright Chromium suites (16/16 passed).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Any future daemon host that directly renders the shared transcript viewport and needs historical turn navigation or message deletion must inject the daemon session viewport component, and any daemon host rendering daemon MCP or tasks status messages must supply the status-card context (the main app, split pane, and standalone transcript viewer all do so and are covered by tests).
- Not validated / out of scope: The managed-host CI workflow retains its existing prerequisite workspace builds (browser-safe core subpaths and type-only SDK references remain valid inputs).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. No HTTP/SSE routes, OpenAPI schemas, storage keys, i18n keys, or user-visible behaviors change.
- Design documentation: [English design doc](docs/design/2026-11-28-managed-host-zero-daemon-cleanup.md) | [中文设计文档](docs/design/2026-11-28-managed-host-zero-daemon-cleanup.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Final slice (6c) of #17460

<summary>中文说明</summary>

本 PR 完成统一聊天界面路线图的收官切片 6c，将托管宿主打包入口剩余的最后十六条传递 daemon 值导入边彻底清零（全路线图累计从四十七条降至零条），删除源代码边界测试中的过渡白名单棘轮，并在托管宿主 CI 工作流中落位零 daemon 运行时产物门禁。

- **纯叶节点工具与错误判断解耦（清除四条边）：** 将钩子统计汇总改由共享核心包的浏览器安全子路径直接提供，将目标状态消息前缀常量本地化并与 daemon SDK 做单测对等，将后台回合载荷解析抽至浏览器安全纯工具并逐子句对等校验，并将产物 HTTP 404/会话不存在错误判断改为基于错误名称与数字状态码的结构化校验且与 daemon SDK 对等测试。
- **浏览器通知设置上下文拆分（清除一条边）：** 将浏览器通知设置上下文与只读 hook 拆出至零 daemon 导入的独立模块，由原通知模块保留重导出，使审批卡片中的通知帮助控件不再传递拉入 daemon 通知上下文。
- **Daemon 转录历史视口拆分（清除五条边）：** 将依赖 daemon 会话历史导航与消息删除的视口实现原样拆至独立的 daemon 视口组件，共享转录视口保持纯实时列表形态并通过可选属性接收宿主注入的会话视口组件，由主应用列与分屏聊天窗格显式传入，托管宿主天然省略。
- **Daemon 状态子卡上下文（清除四条边）：** 新增中立的状态子卡渲染上下文，将 MCP 状态卡与任务状态卡渲染器绑定在 daemon 专用常量中，由主应用外壳、分屏聊天窗格及离线导出转录视图注入，而无头工作区 Provider 与共享系统消息组件均不再导入这两类 daemon 状态子卡。
- **共享工作区运行时上下文（清除两条边）：** 抽出模块级中立工作区运行时上下文并直接复用于工作区 Provider，同时将工作区产物目标解析逻辑原样抽为可空运行时版本；共享回合产物与工具文件预览按钮改读该可选上下文，在无 daemon 工作区 Provider 时安全降级而不抛错，原 daemon 封装保持向后兼容。
- **归零边界守卫与 CI 零 daemon 产物门禁：** 删除托管宿主边界测试中的剩余边白名单并直接断言零 daemon 边与零未解析说明符；在托管宿主构建工作流中新增八个经压缩产物实测验证的活 daemon 运行时签名检查，凡有任一签名泄露进托管宿主任意输出分片即立即阻断 CI，并同步更新对应的工作流元测试。

## 为什么需要这个改动

在切片 6a（四十七降至三十一）与切片 6b（三十一降至十六）完成后，托管宿主入口依赖图中仍残留最后十六条与转录历史、消息删除、审批通知、状态子卡及工作区文件预览耦合的 daemon 值导入边，且托管宿主 CI 车道尚缺少对输出产物不含 daemon 运行时代码的负向校验。清零这最后十六条边并移除过渡白名单后，托管宿主在源码级 AST 解析与最终打包产物两道防线上同时实现真正的零 daemon 依赖，正式完成统一聊天界面隔离架构的闭环。

## 评审测试计划

### 验证方法

1. 运行托管宿主边界守卫单测，确认聊天核心递归零 daemon 导入、零控制器后端判别字段读取，且托管宿主入口传递值导入图达到精确零条 daemon 边与零条未解析说明符（过渡白名单已完全移除）。
2. 运行工作流元测试与全部受影响的 web-shell 单元测试套件（涵盖后台回合与产物 HTTP 错误对等校验、目标状态前缀对等、钩子统计、系统消息与状态子卡注入、浏览器通知控件、工具文件预览、回合产物、转录视口与分屏窗格、工作区 Provider 共享上下文、托管会话页、构建产物检查及主应用接线用例），确认全部通过且在无工作区或无状态子卡 Provider 时共享组件均安全降级。
3. 执行全仓 TypeScript 类型检查（含集成测试的模块解析检查）、托管宿主与主 web-shell 双构建、ESLint 与 Prettier 格式检查，并针对生成的托管宿主打包目录执行工作流中的八项负向签名校验，确认全部零命中、零报错。
4. 运行内置的 Playwright Chromium 端到端套件（分屏持久化、会话定时任务、托管附件、托管本地文件），确认 daemon 与托管界面行为与主分支一致且无页面错误或控制台报错。

### 测试环境（可选）

本地 macOS 开发环境：Vitest（23 个受影响 web-shell 测试文件 / 1,237 项测试通过，含零边 AST 边界守卫与 47 项构建产物检查；主应用接线用例 2/2 通过；工作流元测试 11/11 通过）、web-shell 与托管宿主生产构建及本地重放 CI 八项负向产物门禁（零 daemon 签名泄露）、ESLint（`--max-warnings=0`）、Prettier 格式检查、全仓 `npm run typecheck`（含集成测试 `nodenext` 解析）以及内置 Playwright Chromium 端到端套件（16/16 通过）。

## 风险与范围

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): align serverRevision ceiling across contract, management and persistence
prs.body:
## What this PR does

`serverRevision` had three different ceilings. The OpenAPI contract and the `ManagedMcpManagementService.requireSnapshot` counter accepted 2^53-1, while the extension-record `count()` rule clamped a wider max down to 2^53-2. A revision of exactly 2^53-1 therefore passed admission and was refused later, and the refusal printed the caller's unclamped max — one higher than the bound actually enforced. This PR moves the contract, the management read path, the CLI pins and the persistence admission shape onto the single shared ceiling, and makes the refusal message report the bound it enforces.

## Why it's needed

The record contract fixes counts at 2^53-2 (`docs/design/2026-09-27-managed-extension-record-contract.md`), and the TypeScript `assertManagedSessionSequence` rejects `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` outright. The public contract was the outlier: it advertised a ceiling the persistence layer never accepted. After this change a snapshot the harness may legally return is also one the published contract permits, so the service can no longer relay a response its own contract calls invalid.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `packages/core`: `npx vitest run src/managed-runtime/managed-mcp-record.test.ts` — the shared fixtures are read by both the TypeScript and the Java reader, so a passing run confirms the two agree on the boundary.
- The `unsafe-server-revision` fixture now patches `run.definition.definitionRevision` alongside `serverRevision`. With only `serverRevision` patched, the pin-equality rule in `pinnedRun` refused the record on its own, so the case passed even with the ceiling guard removed; with both patched it fails only if the `MAX_SAFE_COUNTER` guard is what refuses it. `max-server-revision` is the positive counterpart at 2^53-2.
- `ManagedMcpRecordContractTest#boundsEveryPublicMcpSequenceAtTheSharedCeiling` mirrors that pair against the Java record and asserts the refusal names the enforced ceiling.
- `node scripts/check-contract-version.js <base> <head>` — the document changes six `maximum` values, so `info.version` advances to 1.112.0 past main's 1.111.0.

Expected: the whole boundary sits at 2^53-2 on every layer, and a 2^53-1 value is refused with a message that states 9007199254740990.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — contract and validation change, no user-visible surface.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Node 24, vitest from the worktree's `node_modules`. Java was not built — see Risk & Scope.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: historical data can exist. The persisted managed-record layer has always clamped at 2^53-2 (`ManagedExtensionRecords.MAX_COUNT`), but the management-command path admitted 2^53-1 on both sides before this change — `ApiModels.ManagedMcpServerPin` declared `@Max(9_007_199_254_740_991L)` and `parseHostedMcpServers` only required `Number.isSafeInteger`, so a Session created earlier can hold a `…991` selection. Such a Session now fails `requireSnapshot` and its management read path returns `managed_mcp_management_unavailable` (503), consistent with the existing `Invalid MCP management snapshot` failure mode. The same spread reaches the persistence read path too: `readHostedMcpSettings` (`packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-mcp-settings.ts:189`, which calls `parseHostedMcpServers` at :244) throws `Invalid MCP settings.` for an existing `…991` pin. That behaviour was not traced further into Session open, so its blast radius there is unverified. I took the convergence rather than rolling back the response maxima, because a rollback leaves the contract advertising a bound the persistence layer refuses.
- Not validated / out of scope: the Java module was not compiled or tested on this machine — it has no JDK or Maven (`/usr/bin/java` is a stub), so `ManagedMcpRecordContractTest`, `ManagedAgentApiContractTest`, `ManagedMcpManagementServiceTest` and checkstyle are left to CI. `ManagedDiagnosticMcpServer.serverRevision`, `ManagedToolMeasurements.MAX_COUNT` and the client-side `Number.isSafeInteger` guards stay where they are; they are consistent with their own code and only ever wider, so they are not a regression of this change. The repository-wide `npm run build` also fails in `packages/channels/github` on this checkout for an unrelated missing cross-package type.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for well-formed data; the only observable change is the rejection described above.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16886

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

`serverRevision` 此前有三个不同的上限。OpenAPI 契约和 `ManagedMcpManagementService.requireSnapshot` 的计数器接受 2^53-1，而扩展记录的 `count()` 规则会把更宽的 max 夹到 2^53-2。于是恰好等于 2^53-1 的 revision 能通过准入、之后才被拒，而且拒绝信息打印的是调用方传入的、未夹紧的 max —— 比真正生效的上界高 1。本 PR 把契约、management 读路径、CLI pin 和持久化准入形状统一到同一个共享上限，并让拒绝信息播报它真正执行的界限。

## 为什么需要

记录契约把计数定在 2^53-2（`docs/design/2026-09-27-managed-extension-record-contract.md`），TypeScript 的 `assertManagedSessionSequence` 也直接拒绝 `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`。公开契约才是那个例外：它宣传了一个持久化层从不接受的上限。改动之后，harness 可以合法返回的快照，也是已发布契约允许的值，服务端不会再转发被自家契约判为非法的响应。

### 如何验证

- `packages/core`：`npx vitest run src/managed-runtime/managed-mcp-record.test.ts`。共享夹具由 TypeScript 与 Java 两个读取器共用，通过即说明两者在边界上一致。
- `unsafe-server-revision` 夹具现在同时 patch `run.definition.definitionRevision` 与 `serverRevision`。此前只 patch `serverRevision` 时，`pinnedRun` 的 pin 相等规则自己就会拒绝它，所以即使移除上界守卫该用例仍然通过；两者都 patch 后，只有 `MAX_SAFE_COUNTER` 守卫才是拒绝的原因。`max-server-revision` 是 2^53-2 的正向对照。

- `node scripts/check-contract-version.js <base> <head>`：文档改了六处 `maximum`，因此 `info.version` 推进到 1.112.0，越过 main 的 1.111.0。

预期：边界在每一层都是 2^53-2，2^53-1 被拒且信息中写明 9007199254740990。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：已存储且带 `serverRevision = 2^53-1` 的记录会使 `requireSnapshot` 失败，对该 Session 表现为 `managed_mcp_management_unavailable`（503）。写入路径一直是按 2^53-2 夹紧的（`ManagedExtensionRecords.MAX_COUNT`），所以健康系统不可能产生这种记录；若确有历史脏数据，该 503 与既有的 `Invalid MCP management snapshot` 失败模式一致。我选择收敛而不是回退四处响应上限，因为回退会让契约继续宣传一个持久化层拒绝的限制。

prs.title: docs(managed-agent): Design Harness pull for released Sessions (P1)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This adds the design for phase P1 of pull scheduling in #18514, in English and Chinese. It also carries three small follow-ups to the merged event ingest work. There are no production code changes.

A released Session (after a clean idle suspension or Action park) is today placed by Java: the pool picks an accepting member round robin and pushes the work to it. The design lets a Hosted Harness claim such a Session instead, over an outbound long poll that reports its free cold-open slots. When a push path would take over a placement that is not active, it records claim demand on the Session row and waits; a poller with capacity claims it through the existing placement takeover CAS. Demand is recorded even when no push member is reachable. If nothing claims the demand within 30 seconds, the push path assigns as it does today and clears the demand in the same step, so pollers stop seeing the Session while the member opens it. A Session with no placement yet, such as a new Session's first Turn, is still assigned at once, because a claim can only take over an existing placement.

The claim adds the reservation contract discussed on the issue. The takeover that consumes a release receipt cuts the sealed writer's lease to the current time, so today any later takeover can displace a member that has been assigned but has not yet acquired the writer. A claim now carries a 30-second reservation in database time. After a lost response, the same poller gets the same claim back. Other pollers get nothing until the reservation expires. Writer acquisition consumes it under the placement lock, and a grant from an earlier epoch is still refused at acquisition.

A claimed Session is then served without Java knowing or reaching the holder's address. Every call Java makes for it becomes a request item that the holder receives in its own poll and answers, carried by the same connector and SDK logic over a different transport. Every connector path that looks up the Session's owner goes through the channel, not only ordinary calls. The holder runs each request through its own HTTP handler with its own server token, and returns the response headers the SDK client checks, so the client's boot check still sees the Harness that ran it. A poll returns a bounded number of items. Items expire at their caller's deadline, and a sweep deletes them; Session retirement deletes them too. A holder whose poll loop stalls stops renewing its writer leases, so its Sessions become claimable again. Request items never store credentials. No Turn on such a Session opens a Harness event stream. Where the dispatcher would open one, it hands the Turn's lease to the holder and asks it to push its events from the Turn's cursor. A cancel is delivered to the holder instead of taking the Turn back. That hand-off must also accept a cancelling Turn, which the admission hand-off in #18557 does not, so it is new work in the second slice.

P1 is split into two slices. The first slice covers claims, the reservation, the push-side gate and wake work. It does not depend on event ingest, and it keeps one transitional rule that issues claims only to configured pool members, because other calls still reach the claimer by push. The second slice adds the holder channel and stream-free Turns, removes that rule for pollers that advertise a new holder-channel feature, and builds on the event ingest merged in #18557. A poller without that feature stays under the first slice's rule even after the second slice is enabled, so a mixed-version rollout cannot leave a Session with a holder that never reads its requests.

The three follow-ups to #18557 and #18509:

- The event ingest design's list of affected files now credits the Turn hand-off to the store collaborator it moved into before #18557 merged.
- The committed snapshot of the Managed Agent route surface now includes the event ingest Store route. #18509 registered the route without re-capturing the snapshot, so the surface check has failed in the Managed Agent full suite since then.
- The cli capability parity matrix now classifies that route as an internal Store route. Without it, the new snapshot fails the cli parity test.

## Why it's needed

Java places a released Session before it knows whether the member can open it. A member at its cold-open limit refuses, the Session waits on that member, and an idle or newly added member gets nothing until round robin reaches it. Every call also needs Java to know and reach the member, which ties the Harness to a static pool inside the Java Pod. Letting the Harness claim work when it has capacity, and serving what it holds through its own poll, removes both. It is the next step after event ingest on the path to scaling the Harness independently.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Read the English and Chinese versions side by side. They should have the same sections, decisions, tables, constraints, acceptance criteria and open questions.
- Check the current-state claims against `main` at `8327d40b17`, which includes #18557:
  - the round-robin selection, with its separate assign and takeover branches, in the pool connector;
  - the lease cut when a takeover consumes a release receipt;
  - writer acquisition locking the placement before the head;
  - the wake scan's 30-second retry delay;
  - the dispatcher treating the placement wait codes as pool waits;
  - the three places the dispatcher opens a Harness stream;
  - the merged hand-off accepting only a running Turn.
- Check that the push-side gate in §6 leaves a Session without a placement to be assigned at once, records demand before looking for an accepting member, and clears the demand when the fallback assigns. Check that each push-path cell of the reservation table in §5 names the code a test should assert.
- Check §7 against the SDK client and the Harness app. A reply should carry the boot header from the Harness's own response, a replayed request should carry the holder's own token, and every owner lookup should be routed through the channel.
- Check the mixed-version row in §10: a poller without the holder-channel feature claims only as a configured member, and its calls go by push.
- Check the reservation table in §5 against the lost-response scenarios raised on #18514, including the inverted ordering where the claimer acquires just before the deadline.
- Check that the flag-off and pre-rollout behaviors in §10 match what an operator would expect. In particular, enabling the second slice before the Harness rollout delays released Sessions by the fallback.
- Review §15:
  - the shared-token identity risk, which now states that a Harness polling in another's name can use the writer tokens in its claims against the Store;
  - the cost and latency of the holder channel;
  - how long request content stays at rest, now bounded by the sweep and Session retirement.
- Check that the surface snapshot change adds only the event ingest route and the digest, that the surface check passes, and that the cli capability parity test passes with it.

Local checks:

- Prettier passes on all four design files, and the language links resolve in both directions.
- The two versions of each design have the same headings, table rows and backticked identifiers.
- The surface check passes locally after the re-capture.
- The cli capability parity test passes locally.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — design documents and a test snapshot only.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ (surface check, cli parity test) |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A |
|  🐧 Linux  | N/A |

### Environment (optional)

JDK 21, Maven 3.10.0 and H2 for the surface check; Node 22 for the cli parity test.

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff.** The design trades Java's direct calls for a request channel through SQL and the holder's poll.
  - That adds a few writes and up to a 100 ms reply recheck per call across Java instances. Cancellation and approval latency through it still have to be measured against today's direct calls.
  - The Harness bearer token is shared and boot IDs are not secrets. A Harness can therefore poll in another's name and use the writer tokens in that Harness's claims directly against the Store. P1 is therefore stated as safe only where every Harness holding the token is equally trusted, inside the Java Pod's trust boundary. Per-instance identity is required before any other Harness polls.
- **Not validated / out of scope.** Nothing in the design is implemented. Placing Sessions without a placement (a new Session's first Turn), side queries, Java-side reads and removing the private listener remain for later phases. The Hosted MySQL failures that the Managed Agent full suite also reports predate this PR and are not addressed here.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes.** None in this PR. The design itself keeps a disabled-by-default flag and edits the V1 schema baseline in place, as the module requires before its first release.

Design document: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/docs/managed-harness-pull-p1/docs/design/2026-11-27-managed-harness-pull-released-sessions.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/docs/managed-harness-pull-p1/docs/design/2026-11-27-managed-harness-pull-released-sessions.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized.

## Linked Issues

Refs #18514. Builds on #18404 and the event ingest work (#18509, #18519, #18557).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

本 PR 以中英两种语言加入 #18514 中拉取调度 P1 阶段的设计，并附带三处针对已合并的事件上报工作的小修复。不包含生产代码改动。

已释放的 Session（干净的空闲挂起或 Action 停靠之后）现在由 Java 放置：池按轮询挑一个接受新工作的成员，再把工作推给它。本设计改由 Hosted Harness 认领这样的 Session：Harness 通过向外的长轮询上报自己空闲的冷启动槽位。推送路径要接管一个非活跃的 placement 时，改为在 Session 行上记录认领需求并等待；有容量的 poller 通过现有的 placement takeover CAS 认领它。即使没有可达的推送成员，也会记录需求。如果 30 秒内没有人认领，推送路径按现在的方式分配，并在同一步中清除需求，使成员打开该 Session 期间 poller 不再看到它。还没有 placement 的 Session（例如新 Session 的第一个 Turn）仍立即分配，因为认领只能接管已有的 placement。

认领加入了 issue 中讨论的预留契约。消费 release 回执的 takeover 会把已 seal 的 writer 租约截到当前时间，因此现在任何后续 takeover 都能挤掉一个已被分配、但尚未获取 writer 的成员。现在认领带有一个数据库时间 30 秒的预留。响应丢失后，同一 poller 拿回同一个认领。预留过期前，其他 poller 什么也拿不到。获取 writer 时在 placement 锁下消费预留，来自更早 epoch 的授权在获取 writer 时仍会被拒绝。

被认领的 Session 随后在 Java 不知道也连不到持有者地址的情况下得到服务。Java 为它发出的每一次调用都变成一个请求项，由持有者在自己的 poll 中收到并应答，承载调用的仍是同一套连接器和 SDK 逻辑，只是换了一种传输。每一条查找 Session owner 的连接器路径都经过通道，而不只是普通调用。持有者用自己的 HTTP 处理逻辑和自己的服务 token 执行每个请求，并回传 SDK 客户端会校验的响应头，因此客户端的 boot 校验看到的仍是实际执行请求的 Harness。一次 poll 返回的请求项有上限。请求项在调用方的截止时间过期，由清扫删除；Session 退役时也会删除。poll 循环停滞的持有者会停止续租 writer 租约，于是它的 Session 可以重新被认领。请求项从不保存凭据。这样的 Session 上不会有 Turn 打开 Harness 事件流。派发器原本要打开事件流的地方，改为把 Turn 的租约交给持有者，并请它从 Turn 的游标处推送事件。取消则送达持有者，而不是收回 Turn。这个交接还必须接受取消中的 Turn，而 #18557 中的准入交接不接受，因此它属于第二个切片的新工作。

P1 分为两个切片。第一个切片包括认领、预留、推送侧闸门和 wake 工作。它不依赖事件上报，并保留一条过渡规则：只向已配置的池成员发放认领，因为其他调用仍经推送送达认领者。第二个切片加入持有者通道和无事件流的 Turn，对声明了新的持有者通道特性的 poller 解除这条规则，并建立在 #18557 合并的事件上报之上。不含该特性的 poller 在第二个切片启用后仍受第一个切片的规则约束，因此混合版本发布时，不会出现 Session 被一个从不读取其请求的持有者占住的情况。

针对 #18557 和 #18509 的三处后续修复：

- 事件上报设计的涉及文件清单，现在把 Turn 交接记在 #18557 合并前它被移入的那个 store 协作类名下。
- 已提交的 Managed Agent 路由清单快照现在包含事件上报的 Store 路由。#18509 登记了该路由，但没有重新捕获快照，所以路由清单检查从那以后一直在 Managed Agent 全量套件中失败。
- cli 的能力一致性矩阵现在把该路由归类为内部 Store 路由。否则新的快照会让 cli 一致性测试失败。

## 为什么需要

Java 在知道成员能否打开 Session 之前就放置了它。达到冷启动上限的成员会拒绝，Session 一直等这个成员，而空闲或新加入的成员要等轮询轮到它才能拿到工作。每次调用还要求 Java 知道并能连到该成员，这把 Harness 绑在了 Java Pod 内的静态池上。让 Harness 在有容量时认领工作、并通过自己的 poll 服务已持有的 Session，可以同时消除这两点。这是事件上报之后、走向 Harness 独立扩缩容的下一步。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 对照阅读中英两个版本。它们应有相同的章节、决策、表格、约束、验收标准和待定问题。
- 对照 `main` 的 `8327d40b17`（已包含 #18557）检查现状描述：
  - 池连接器中的轮询选择，以及其中分开的 assign 与 takeover 分支；
  - takeover 消费 release 回执时对租约的截断；
  - 获取 writer 时先锁 placement 再处理 head；
  - wake 扫描 30 秒的重试延迟；
  - 派发器把 placement 等待码当作池等待；
  - 派发器打开 Harness 事件流的三个位置；
  - 已合并的交接只接受运行中的 Turn。
- 检查 §6 的推送侧闸门让没有 placement 的 Session 立即分配，在查找可接收成员之前记录需求，并在兜底分配时清除需求。检查 §5 预留表中推送路径的每一格都写明了测试应断言的错误码。
- 对照 SDK 客户端和 Harness 应用检查 §7：应答应携带取自 Harness 自身响应的 boot 头，重放的请求应带持有者自己的 token，每一次 owner 查找都应经过通道路由。
- 检查 §10 中混合版本的那一行：不含持有者通道特性的 poller 只能以已配置成员身份认领，调用经推送。
- 对照 #18514 中提出的响应丢失场景检查 §5 的预留表，包括认领者恰好在截止时间之前获取 writer 的反向顺序。
- 检查 §10 中开关关闭和发布之前的行为是否符合运维预期。特别是，在 Harness 发布之前开启第二个切片，会让已释放 Session 多等一个兜底时长。
- 评审 §15：
  - 共享 token 带来的身份风险，现在写明了冒名 poll 的 Harness 能直接用其认领中的 writer token 调 Store；
  - 持有者通道的成本和延迟；
  - 请求内容的落库保留时长，现在由清扫和 Session 退役限定。
- 检查路由清单快照的改动只新增了事件上报路由和摘要，路由清单检查通过，且 cli 能力一致性测试随之通过。

本地检查：

- 四个设计文件都通过 Prettier，语言链接双向可达。
- 每份设计的两个版本标题、表格行和反引号标识符都一致。
- 重新捕获后，本地路由清单检查通过。
- 本地 cli 能力一致性测试通过。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用——仅设计文档和测试快照。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅（路由清单检查、cli 一致性测试） |
| 🪟 Windows | 不适用 |
|  🐧 Linux  | 不适用 |

### 环境（可选）

路由清单检查使用 JDK 21、Maven 3.10.0 和 H2；cli 一致性测试使用 Node 22。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或取舍。** 本设计用一条经 SQL 和持有者 poll 的请求通道替代 Java 的直接调用。
  - 跨 Java 实例时，每次调用会多出几次写入和最多 100 毫秒的应答重查。经由它的取消和审批延迟仍需与现在的直接调用对比测量。
  - Harness bearer token 是共享的，boot ID 也不是秘密，所以一个 Harness 可以冒名 poll，并直接用对方认领中的 writer token 调 Store。因此本设计写明：只有持有该 token 的每个 Harness 都同等可信、且都在 Java Pod 的信任边界之内时，P1 才是安全的。在其他 Harness poll 之前，必须有逐实例身份。
- **未验证 / 不在范围内。** 设计中的内容都没有实现。放置还没有 placement 的 Session（新 Session 的第一个 Turn）、side query、Java 侧读取以及移除私有监听器，留给之后的阶段。Managed Agent 全量套件中同时报告的 Hosted MySQL 失败早于本 PR，本 PR 不处理。
- **破坏性变更 / 迁移说明。** 本 PR 没有。设计本身保留一个默认关闭的开关，并按模块在首次发布前的要求原地修改 V1 schema baseline。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/docs/managed-harness-pull-p1/docs/design/2026-11-27-managed-harness-pull-released-sessions.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/docs/managed-harness-pull-p1/docs/design/2026-11-27-managed-harness-pull-released-sessions.zh-CN.md)。两个版本完整且同步。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #18514。基于 #18404 以及事件上报工作（#18509、#18519、#18557）。

</details>

auto_merge.commit_message:
* docs(managed-agent): Design Harness pull for released Sessions (P1)

Propose phase P1 of pull scheduling: a Hosted Harness claims released
Sessions with free capacity over an outbound long poll, instead of Java
placing them round robin. The claim reuses the placement takeover CAS
and adds a bounded reservation between assignment and writer
acquisition. Claimed Sessions are then served through a holder channel
of request items delivered in the holder's own poll, and their Turns
never open a Harness event stream, so Java needs neither the holder's
address nor a member list. English and Chinese versions are included.

Refs #18514

* docs(managed-agent): Scope the pull gate to takeovers and correct its threat model

Address the review of the Harness pull design. The push-side gate now
covers only a takeover of a placement that is not ACTIVE, so a Session
with no placement, such as a new Session's first Turn, is still assigned
at once; an acceptance criterion pins that. The reservation matrix names
the code each push-path row expects, and a claim whose reservation lapses
is taken over at once when its claimer is unreachable.

The stream-site hand-off is stated as new P1.2 work: #18557's admission
hand-off accepts only a RUNNING Turn, so P1.2 adds a hand-off that also
accepts CANCELLING and narrows the take-back predicate for pull-held
Sessions.

The poller-identity risk now says what the shared token allows: a claim's
writer token is accepted by the Store from any caller, so a Harness
polling in another's name can write as it, not only read. P1 is limited
to equally trusted Harnesses until per-instance identity binds polls and
writer tokens.

The holder channel ties writer renewal to the poll loop, expires
delivered as well as undelivered items on takeover, never stores writer
tokens or the authorization header, and notes content at rest. The
Harness route is spelled events/push for Express 5, and SurfaceRegistry
is placed in the verification module. Both languages are updated.

Refs #18514

* docs(managed-agent): Credit the Turn hand-off to AgentTurnHandOff in the ingest design

#18557 moved the admission hand-off and the CANCELLING take-back
predicate into AgentTurnHandOff, but the ingest design's affected-files
list still credited them to AgentTurnExecution. Split the entry in both
languages.

Refs #18514

* test(managed-agent): Re-capture the managed surface with the event ingest route

#18509 registered STORE_EVENT_INGEST in SurfaceRegistry without
re-capturing managed-surface.txt, so ManagedSurfaceCaptureTest has failed
in the Managed Agent full suite since. Re-capture it; the only change is
the events:ingest line and the route-set digest.

* docs(managed-agent): Refer to the merged #18557 in the past tense

Refs #18514

* test(cli): Classify the event ingest store route as internal in capability parity

* docs(managed-agent): Record demand without push members, authenticate channel replays, and gate pull-held on holder-channel/1

* docs(managed-agent): Bound the holder channel's requests and route every owner lookup through it

---------

Co-authored-by: Shaojin Wen <shaojin.wensj@alibaba-inc.com>

prs.title: feat(verify-pr): add standard guest init/runner and offline ext4 image derivation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This change completes the remaining local Phase 2 microVM pieces so hardware-isolated `/verify-pr` rounds can derive read-only golden guest images and execute the full guest lifecycle end-to-end using only repository scripts, with zero out-of-tree PoC glue, and also lands the two non-blocking follow-ups recorded during PR #18552 review.

First, it adds a standard POSIX PID-1 guest init entrypoint and a zero-dependency Python 3 guest lifecycle runner. Inside a NIC-less microVM, the init script mounts virtual filesystems, enables only loopback networking, scrubs the environment, runs the guest lifecycle runner with kernel command-line overrides, and powers off cleanly on exit. The guest runner executes the full seven-step fail-closed contract over the existing three-port guest vsock transport: fetching and SHA-verifying the input manifest, bundle, and entropy; mixing host-supplied entropy into `/dev/urandom`; inspecting guest interfaces and mounts to confirm no external NIC or host directory share; materializing a clean Git workspace and verifying both base and head commit OIDs (or verifying the Git v2/v3 bundle header and advertised OIDs in pure Python when explicitly opted in for minimal git-less BusyBox images); launching the loopback model bridge and verifying raw `/__health` nonce identity before running any workload; running either a configured workload script in a credential-stripped environment or a built-in self-test that emits checker-compliant verification artifacts; and stopping the bridge cleanly before streaming all artifacts to the host collector.

Second, it adds an offline read-only golden ext4 image derivation tool and CLI. The tool unpacks a read-only golden ext4 base image using `debugfs` without mounting loop devices or opening the golden source for writing, injects the repository's audited guest scripts (and optional workload or host Python runtime), rebuilds an independent ext4 image via `mkfs.ext4`, and re-hashes the golden base image afterwards to confirm it remained byte-identical. It reuses the host staging module's canonical approved-root and vault-exclusion guards, enforces single-link non-symlink sources, optional base SHA-256 pinning, overwrite refusal, in-image path normalization, extraction-tree symlink-escape protection, and full temporary cleanup on error.

Third, it lands the two non-blocking follow-ups from PR #18552: allowing staging directory checks to accept directories equal to a normalized approved root (while preserving strict child containment for file destinations) and recording newly created staging directories immediately after directory creation and before permission adjustment so rollback remains complete if permission changes fail.

## Why it's needed

After PR #18552 landed host capability probing and per-round VMM staging, booting a real Firecracker microVM still depended on out-of-tree PoC scripts to build the guest rootfs and drive PID-1 initialization and vsock orchestration. Moving both the guest lifecycle entrypoint and offline golden ext4 derivation into audited repository scripts with collocated unit tests removes the last external glue from Phase 2, closes image-injection symlink-escape and proxy-squatter nonce risks fail-closed, and resolves the two remaining follow-up notes from #18552.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run the six focused script unit test suites on macOS arm64 (guest runner, offline image derivation, host staging, VM runner, vsock channel, and credential scan), plus POSIX syntax and `shellcheck` verification on the guest init script, Python bytecode compilation on the guest runner, Prettier, ESLint, and repository lint.
- Verify the guest runner end-to-end over real three-port Unix sockets through the host hardware-round orchestrator: confirming 32-byte entropy delivery, exact base/head Git bundle materialization, loopback model-bridge `/__health` raw nonce verification and upstream request proxying without exposing host credentials, artifact upload passing the host verification checker to emit a `microvm` boundary file, host secret stripping for custom workloads, `needs-changes` degradation when non-loopback NICs or shared mounts are present, fail-closed rejection before workload launch when a squatter returns a wrong health nonce, rejection of invalid kernel command-line integers, and pure-Python Git v2/v3 bundle header OID validation.
- Verify offline golden ext4 image derivation safety guards: confirming base SHA-256 pinning, unchanged golden source SHA-256 after build, approved-root and symlinked-vault exclusion, symlink/hardlink source refusal, overwrite refusal, in-image path traversal refusal, blocking a hostile base image that unpacks a symlinked target directory escaping the extraction tree, temporary file cleanup when `mkfs` fails, and CLI argument validation returning exit code 2.
- Verify the #18552 follow-ups: confirming a direct child file inside an approved root succeeds while targeting the approved root itself as a file destination remains refused, and newly created staging directories are recorded before permission adjustment.
- On a Linux aarch64 host with `/dev/kvm`, `debugfs`, `mkfs.ext4`, and Firecracker/jailer, derive an ext4 image from a read-only golden rootfs using the repository CLI and boot it through the host orchestrator with opt-in staging and the verification checker enabled (zero out-of-tree PoC scripts), confirming all guest checks pass, `microvm` boundary output is produced with checker exit 0, per-round jail directories are removed, and golden kernel/rootfs hashes remain unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-UI microVM guest lifecycle scripts, offline image derivation tooling, tests, and design documents).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

- **macOS arm64 / Node 24.18.1:** 6 focused script unit suites passed (**81 passed, 1 root-gated skip, 0 failed**); `python3 -m py_compile`, `sh -n`, `shellcheck -s sh` (0 warnings), Prettier, ESLint, and full repository `npm run lint` passed cleanly.
- **Linux aarch64 / Node 22.23.5 (authorized KVM host):** all 14 `/verify-pr` script unit test files passed (**555 passed, 9 environment skips**); a 100% repository-only Firecracker/KVM end-to-end round derived an ext4 image (`c1ef5982…`) from the read-only golden rootfs via real `debugfs` + `mkfs.ext4`, booted PID-1 guest init and the guest runner with opt-in staging and checker enabled (`qwen.skip_materialize=1` for the git-less minimal BusyBox rootfs), and completed with `ok: true`, checker exit 0, `complete` output, `destroyed` teardown, `microvm` boundary output, 32-byte `/dev/urandom` entropy write, loopback-only networking, zero shared mounts, verified bundle header OIDs, HTTP 200 model probe with upstream auth parity, zero residual jail directories, and unchanged golden kernel/rootfs SHA-256 digests.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Offline ext4 image derivation relies on Linux `e2fsprogs` (`debugfs` and `mkfs.ext4`), so derivation fails closed with a clear missing-tool error on hosts without `e2fsprogs` (such as stock macOS). Minimal git-less BusyBox images require explicitly passing the skip-materialize kernel parameter so missing `git` never silently bypasses repository checkout on standard images.
- Not validated / out of scope: Live Firecracker/KVM boot with a `git`-bearing guest rootfs was not run because the KVM host's minimal BusyBox golden rootfs does not bundle `git` (full Git bundle materialization and custom credential-stripped workloads were exercised end-to-end over real three-port Unix sockets in unit tests). Live macOS `vfkit` VM boot, cloud `provider-vm` / Agent Sandbox allocations, external model endpoints, Windows IPC, and changes under `packages/`, `.github/`, `.qwen/skills/`, or `/review` are out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. Default Firecracker/vfkit launch boot arguments, manual staging, and legacy `container`, manual `vm`, and `waived` `/verify-pr` flows remain fully compatible.
- Design documentation: [English design doc](docs/design/2026-11-28-verify-pr-vm-guest-init-and-image.md) | [中文设计文档](docs/design/2026-11-28-verify-pr-vm-guest-init-and-image.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Follows up on #18552 (closing both remaining non-blocking review notes) and completes local Phase 2 of the tiered microVM roadmap from #18181, #18221, #18277, and #18400.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本次改动补齐本地硬件隔离 `/verify-pr` microVM 阶段 2 的最后两块拼图，使离线只读 golden 镜像派生与完整 guest 生命周期编排全部收敛到仓库内脚本、彻底脱离仓外 PoC 胶水，同时一并落盘 PR #18552 评审中记录的 2 条非阻断 follow-up。

第一，新增标准 POSIX PID-1 guest 启动入口与零第三方依赖的 Python 3 guest 生命周期编排器。在无网卡 microVM 内，启动脚本挂载虚拟文件系统、仅拉起回环接口、清理环境变量、结合内核启动参数调用 guest 编排器，并在结束时干净关机避免 PID-1 panic。guest 编排器基于既有 3 端口 vsock 通道按 7 步 fail-closed 契约运行：拉取并校验输入 manifest、bundle 与熵文件；将宿主提供的 32 字节熵混入 `/dev/urandom`；检查网络接口与挂载表以确认无外网 NIC 与宿主目录共享；从 bundle 物化纯净 Git 工作区并核验 base 与 head 提交 OID（或仅在针对无 `git` 的极简 BusyBox 镜像显式开启跳过物化参数时以纯 Python 校验 Git v2/v3 bundle 头部及其声明的 OID）；当启用模型代理时拉起本地回环桥接并在启动任何工作负载前逐字节校验 `/__health` 裸 nonce；在剥离宿主凭据的环境中执行受控工作脚本或内置自检并产出符合宿主检查器契约的验证产物；最终始终停止桥接并将全部产物上传至宿主收集器。

第二，新增离线只读 golden ext4 镜像派生工具与 CLI。工具仅通过 `debugfs` 只读解包 golden ext4 镜像，不挂载 loop 设备也不以写模式打开源镜像，向提取树注入仓库内受审 guest 脚本（以及可选的工作负载脚本或宿主 Python 运行时），再通过 `mkfs.ext4` 重建独立镜像，并在提升后二次复核只读 golden 源镜像 SHA-256 保持不变。该工具复用宿主 staging 模块的规范化批准根目录与金库排除守卫，强制校验单链接非符号链接输入、可选源 SHA-256 锁定、禁止覆写、镜像内路径规范化、提取树符号链接逃逸拦截与失败全量回滚。

第三，落盘 PR #18552 的 2 条非阻断后续项：允许目录校验接受目录本身等于某个规范化批准根（文件目标仍维持严格子路径约束），并将新建目录记录提前到创建目录之后、权限修改之前，闭合权限修改失败时的回滚窗口。

## 为什么需要

PR #18552 合入宿主探测与每轮 VMM staging 后，真实启动 Firecracker microVM 仍需依赖仓库外临时脚本构建 rootfs 及编排 PID-1 初始化与 vsock 通道。将 guest 启动入口与离线只读镜像派生正式收口入库并配齐端到端单测，使阶段 2 实现零仓外 PoC 胶水运行，同时 fail-closed 封堵恶意基础镜像符号链接逃逸与伪造代理 nonce 风险，并收尾 #18552 留下的两条建议。

## 审阅测试计划

### 验证步骤

- 在 macOS arm64 上运行 6 套聚焦脚本单测（guest 编排器、离线镜像派生、宿主 staging、VM 编排器、vsock 通道与凭据扫描），并对 guest 启动脚本运行 POSIX 语法与 `shellcheck` 检查，对 Python 编排器做语法编译，并运行 Prettier、ESLint 与仓库完整 lint。
- 验证 guest 编排器经真实 3 端口 Unix socket 与宿主硬件轮编排器全链路联调：确认 32 字节熵准确写入、双 OID Git bundle 正确物化、回环桥接校验 `/__health` 裸 nonce 并代理请求而不向 guest 暴露宿主真密钥、上传产物通过宿主验证门禁并产出 `microvm` 边界文件、自定义工作负载看不到宿主秘密环境变量、出现非回环 NIC 或共享目录挂载时降级为 `needs-changes`、代理返回错误 nonce 时在工作负载执行前 fail-closed 拦截、非法内核整数参数被拒，以及纯 Python Git v2/v3 bundle 头部 OID 校验生效。
- 验证离线 golden ext4 镜像派生安全守卫：确认源 SHA-256 锁定、构建后源镜像哈希未变、批准根目录与符号链接金库排除、符号链接/硬链接输入拒绝、禁止覆写、镜像内路径穿越拦截、恶意基础镜像解包出指向外部目录的符号链接时在写入前拦截、`mkfs` 失败时无临时文件残留，以及 CLI 参数错误返回退出码 2。
- 验证 #18552 两条后续项：确认向批准根目录直接写入子文件成功而直接以批准根作为文件目标仍被拒，且新建目录在调整权限前即完成登记。
- 在具备 `/dev/kvm`、`debugfs`、`mkfs.ext4` 与 Firecracker/jailer 的 Linux aarch64 主机上，完全使用仓库内 CLI 派生镜像并开启 staging 与检查器跑通真实 Firecracker/KVM 轮次（零仓外 PoC 脚本），确认全部 guest 检查通过、检查器退出 0 并产出 `microvm` 边界、每轮 jail 目录彻底清理、只读 golden kernel 与 rootfs 哈希未变。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A（非 UI 的 microVM guest 启动脚本、离线镜像派生工具、测试与设计文档）。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 运行环境（可选）

- **macOS arm64 / Node 24.18.1：**6 套聚焦脚本单测通过（**81 通过，1 项 root 门控跳过，0 失败**）；`python3 -m py_compile`、`sh -n`、`shellcheck -s sh`（0 警告）、Prettier、ESLint 与仓库完整 `npm run lint` 均通过。
- **Linux aarch64 / Node 22.23.5（授权 KVM 主机）：**全部 14 份 `/verify-pr` 脚本单测通过（**555 通过，9 项环境跳过**）；100% 零仓外 PoC 脚本的真实 Firecracker/KVM 端到端通过真实 `debugfs` + `mkfs.ext4` 派生镜像（`c1ef5982…`），开启 staging 与检查器启动 PID-1 guest init 与编排器（针对无 `git` 的极简 BusyBox golden rootfs 传入 `qwen.skip_materialize=1`），实测 `ok: true`、检查器退出 0、`complete` 输出、`destroyed` 清理、`microvm` 边界、32 字节 `/dev/urandom` 写入、仅回环网络、0 共享挂载、bundle 头部 OID 校验通过、模型探针 HTTP 200 且上游鉴权一致、零残留 jail 目录，只读 golden kernel 与 rootfs 哈希不变。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：离线 ext4 镜像派生依赖 Linux `e2fsprogs`（`debugfs` 与 `mkfs.ext4`），在未安装该工具的宿主（如默认 macOS）上会明确报缺少工具并 fail-closed。极简无 `git` BusyBox 镜像需显式传入跳过物化内核参数，确保常规镜像绝不会在缺 `git` 时静默跳过代码检出。

- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。既有默认启动参数、手工 staging 以及 legacy `container`、手动 `vm` 与 `waived` `/verify-pr` 流程保持完全兼容。
- 设计文档：[英文设计文档](docs/design/2026-11-28-verify-pr-vm-guest-init-and-image.md) | [中文设计文档](docs/design/2026-11-28-verify-pr-vm-guest-init-and-image.zh-CN.md)。

prs.title: fix(acp): report max_tokens when output recovery leaves the answer truncated
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A response that hits the output limit goes through bounded recovery in `LlmClient`. When every attempt is still truncated the client gives up and resolves the round normally, so by the time the ACP session picks its stop reason the only trace of the truncation is the last response's finish reason — and a round that simply ran out of stream reported `end_turn` regardless.

The session now records whether the turn's last model response ended on `MAX_TOKENS`, and when the turn would otherwise stop as `end_turn` it reports `max_tokens` instead. Cancellation keeps winning over the terminal path, and the session-token-limit and max-turn reasons are unchanged.

Both the unified-agent-loop round and the default path are covered: the flag is set from `LlmEventType.Finished` on the shared loop and from the candidate's `finishReason` on the default stream.

## Why it's needed

An ACP client could not tell an unresolved output limit from a completed answer, so it treated partial text as complete: the turn said `end_turn` even though the model was still mid-answer when the output cap hit. That is the bug in #12113 — a truncated reply is the one case where stopping silently is worse than reporting it, because the client renders half a sentence with no indication that it was cut. Reporting `max_tokens` lets the client decide whether to continue, retry, or surface the truncation.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Two regression tests in `Session.test.ts`, each verified red on unmodified `main` and green with the change:

- shared loop: a round whose only response ends `MAX_TOKENS` now resolves `max_tokens` (was `end_turn`)
- default path: the same, driven through `sendMessageStream`

`npx vitest run` over the whole `Session.test.ts` file: 1439 passed.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — protocol-level stop reason, not user-visible UI. The before/after is asserted in the two tests above: `end_turn` on `main`, `max_tokens` with this change, for the same `MAX_TOKENS` stream.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a turn whose last round ends on `MAX_TOKENS` but whose earlier text is in fact the complete answer now reports `max_tokens`, so a client that auto-continues will ask the model for more where it previously stopped. That is the intended direction — the flag can only be set by a round that actually ended on the output cap — but it is a behaviour change for clients that key off the stop reason.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows and Linux were not run locally. The package-wide suite beyond `Session.test.ts` was not run, and the full `npm run build` was not run. `packages/cli` `tsc --noEmit` in this worktree reports only the pre-existing `TS6305` "output file not built" errors for unbuilt workspace packages, none in the changed files. ESLint on both changed files is clean.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none at the API level. `max_tokens` is a stop reason an ACP client may not have handled before; the value was already part of the protocol, this change makes the session reach it.

## Linked Issues

Closes #12113

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

达到输出上限的响应会在 `LlmClient` 里走上限重试。当每一次尝试都仍然被截断时，客户端会放弃并把该轮当作正常结束返回，因此等到 ACP 会话决定停止原因时，截断的唯一痕迹只剩最后一次响应的结束原因——而一个只是流结束的轮次无论如何都会被报成 `end_turn`。

会话现在会记录该轮最后一次模型响应是否以 `MAX_TOKENS` 结束，并在该轮本来会以 `end_turn` 停止时改报 `max_tokens`。取消仍然优先于终止路径，会话 token 上限的原因和最大轮次的原因保持不变。

统一 agent loop 的轮次和默认路径都已覆盖：共享 loop 从 `LlmEventType.Finished` 置位，默认流从候选响应的 `finishReason` 置位。

## 为什么需要

ACP 客户端原先无法区分「输出被截断后仍未解决」和「答案已经完整」，于是把不完整的文本当成完整内容：即使模型在输出上限处还没写完，该轮也报 `end_turn`。这正是 #12113 里的问题——截断恰是最不该静默停止的情况，因为客户端会渲染半句话却没有任何提示。报 `max_tokens` 让客户端可以自行决定继续、重试还是提示截断。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

`Session.test.ts` 里两个回归测试，都先确认在未修改的 `main` 上红、改动后绿：

- 共享 loop：只有一次响应且以 `MAX_TOKENS` 结束的轮次，现在解析为 `max_tokens`（原来是 `end_turn`）
- 默认路径：同样场景，经 `sendMessageStream` 驱动

整个 `Session.test.ts` 文件 `npx vitest run`：1439 个通过。

### Evidence (Before & After)

不适用 —— 这是协议层的停止原因，不是用户可见界面。前后差异由上面两个测试断言：同一条 `MAX_TOKENS` 流，`main` 上是 `end_turn`，本改动后是 `max_tokens`。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

## Risk & Scope

- 主要风险或取舍：如果某一轮最后一次是 `MAX_TOKENS` 结束、但前面的文本其实已经是完整答案，现在会报 `max_tokens`，于是自动继续的客户端会要求模型多写一段，而以前会停下。这是预期的方向——该标记只可能由真正撞上输出上限的那一轮置位——但对依赖停止原因判断的客户端来说是行为变化。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：Windows 和 Linux 未在本地运行。除 `Session.test.ts` 之外的包级套件未运行，完整 `npm run build` 也未运行。该 worktree 里 `packages/cli` 的 `tsc --noEmit` 只报未构建 workspace 包的既有 `TS6305` 错误，改动文件内没有报错。两个改动文件的 ESLint 干净。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：API 层无变更。`max_tokens` 是 ACP 客户端以前可能没处理过的停止原因；该取值本来就在协议里，本改动只是让会话能够走到它。

## Linked Issues

Closes #12113

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): show the resolved global directory in the permissions dialogs
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The permissions dialog's "User settings" row now names the settings file the running process actually uses. The resolved global settings path is rendered through the existing `Saved in {{path}}` message and shortened to `~` for display, so a default install still reads `~/.qwen/settings.json` while a `QWEN_HOME` install reads its own path; long relocated paths are middle-compressed so the file name stays visible in the row at an 80-column terminal.

Both renderers are updated: the ink dialog and its OpenTUI parity copy. The hardcoded `Saved in at ~/.qwen/settings.json` message is retired, and `Saved in {{path}}` — which had no entry in any bundled locale, so the memory manager was silently falling back to English for that row — now exists in all nine locales and is listed in `MUST_TRANSLATE_KEYS`, so a future locale sync cannot drop it again without a failing test.

## Why it's needed

Addresses the dialog half of #15628. `Storage.getGlobalSettingsPath()` already honours `QWEN_HOME`, and the permissions dialog was the one place that ignored it: with `QWEN_HOME=/tmp/custom-qwen` the process reads `/tmp/custom-qwen/settings.json` while the User-settings row points at `~/.qwen/settings.json`. Because the row reads the resolved directory rather than a fixed string, it also follows the config-directory move planned in #15458 without another edit.

This is deliberately only the dialog half of the issue. The setting descriptions and the published VS Code schema are untouched: `scripts/generate-settings-schema.ts` copies `setting.description` verbatim into the shipped schema, so interpolating a resolved path there would freeze the build machine's home directory into the artifact, and that half is coupled to #15458 anyway.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `QWEN_HOME=/tmp/custom-qwen npm run dev`, run `/permissions`, open the User settings scope → the row names `/tmp/custom-qwen/settings.json`.
2. Unset `QWEN_HOME`, repeat → the row names `~/.qwen/settings.json`.
3. `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/ui/opentui/dialogs-permissions.test.ts src/ui/components/PermissionsDialog.test.tsx src/ui/components/MemoryDialog.test.tsx` → all pass.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, on the parent commit, with the new assertions in place: `expected 'Saved in at ~/.qwen/settings.json' to be 'Saved in /var/folders/…/settings.json'` — both scope-item tests failed.

After: 13 tests in the OpenTUI permissions suite, 2 in the ink scope-item suite, and 17 in the memory dialog suite pass.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Windows was not run; the only platform-sensitive part is the separator, and both tests build their expectations from `path.sep`. The Linux run used a clean `node:22-bookworm` checkout of this branch.

### Environment (optional)

`packages/cli` unit tests on the host, plus the same suite in a `node:22-bookworm` container for the Linux check.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: nine locale entries change, because the old key is retired and the placeholder key is added. Rendering in every bundled language is unchanged for a default install — only the path itself now varies.
- Not validated / out of scope: no interactive TUI screenshot; the rendered description is covered through the exported scope-item helpers rather than through a full dialog render.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: a custom locale pack that translated `Saved in at ~/.qwen/settings.json` will no longer be consulted for this row; the bundled locales carry the new key.

## Linked Issues

Related to #15628 — this ships the dialog half only. The setting descriptions and the published VS Code schema stay open on the issue until that half lands.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

权限对话框里"用户设置"这一行，现在显示的是进程实际使用的设置文件。解析后的全局设置路径通过已有的 `Saved in {{path}}` 消息渲染，并做 `~` 缩写，因此默认安装仍显示 `~/.qwen/settings.json`，而设置了 `QWEN_HOME` 的安装会显示它自己的路径；被重定向到别处的长路径会做中间段压缩，保证在 80 列终端下文件名仍然可见。

两个渲染器都改了：ink 对话框和它的 OpenTUI 对等实现。硬编码的 `Saved in at ~/.qwen/settings.json` 消息被退役；而 `Saved in {{path}}` 原本在所有内置语言包里都没有条目，导致记忆管理器的那一行一直在悄悄回落成英文，现在九个语言包都补齐了，并已加入 `MUST_TRANSLATE_KEYS`，将来语言包同步若丢掉它，测试会直接变红。

## 为什么需要

处理 #15628 的对话框这一半。`Storage.getGlobalSettingsPath()` 本来就认 `QWEN_HOME`，权限对话框是唯一忽略它的地方：`QWEN_HOME=/tmp/custom-qwen` 时进程读的是 `/tmp/custom-qwen/settings.json`，而"用户设置"那一行却指向 `~/.qwen/settings.json`。由于这一行改为读取解析后的目录，它也会自动跟随 #15458 计划中的配置目录迁移，不需要再改一次。

这个 PR 刻意只做 issue 的对话框这一半。设置项描述和对外发布的 VS Code schema 没有动：`scripts/generate-settings-schema.ts` 会把 `setting.description` 原样写进发布的 schema，在那里插值会把构建机的 home 目录固化进产物；而且那一半本来就依赖 #15458。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. `QWEN_HOME=/tmp/custom-qwen npm run dev`，执行 `/permissions`，打开"用户设置"作用域 → 该行显示 `/tmp/custom-qwen/settings.json`。
2. 取消 `QWEN_HOME`，重复上述步骤 → 该行显示 `~/.qwen/settings.json`。
3. `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/ui/opentui/dialogs-permissions.test.ts src/ui/components/PermissionsDialog.test.tsx src/ui/components/MemoryDialog.test.tsx` → 全部通过。

### 证据（修复前 / 修复后）

修复前（父提交，已带新断言）：`expected 'Saved in at ~/.qwen/settings.json' to be 'Saved in /var/folders/…/settings.json'` —— 两个作用域断言均失败。

修复后：OpenTUI 权限套件 13 个、ink 作用域套件 2 个、记忆对话框套件 17 个用例全部通过。

### 测试平台

|    系统    | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

Windows 未运行；唯一与平台相关的部分是路径分隔符，两个测试的期望值都由 `path.sep` 拼出。Linux 侧用的是本分支的干净 `node:22-bookworm` 检出。

### 环境（可选）

宿主上跑 `packages/cli` 单测，另在 `node:22-bookworm` 容器里跑同一套用例作为 Linux 验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：九个语言包条目发生变化，因为旧 key 退役、占位符 key 新增。默认安装下各语言的渲染结果不变，变化的只是路径本身。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：没有交互式 TUI 截图；渲染结果通过导出的作用域条目辅助函数覆盖，而非完整对话框渲染。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：自定义语言包（用户 locales 目录）里翻译过 `Saved in at ~/.qwen/settings.json` 的条目对这一行不再生效，内置语言包已带新 key。

## 关联 issue

关联 #15628（不自动关闭）——本 PR 只做对话框这一半。设置项描述与对外发布的 VS Code schema 仍需在该 issue 上继续跟进，待那一半落地后再关闭。

</details>
