prs.title: fix(config): declare model.chatCompression knobs and allow disabling image payload eviction
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes image-payload eviction switchable off, and declares the `model.chatCompression` settings that the runtime already reads.

The eviction threshold now accepts `0`, which means "never rewrite image payloads out of history". The eviction pass is skipped entirely in that case, so the stored history keeps every inline image and so does the outgoing request on an image-capable route. A route whose model declares no image support is still slimmed to `[image: ...]` placeholders before the request is sent.

Declaring these knobs as `integer` also makes them settable through `/config`: `integer` was missing from `SETTABLE_TYPES`, so `/config` now lists 272 rows instead of 248 — the six knobs here plus 18 pre-existing integer settings that were settable but invisible.

`model.chatCompression` was declared in the settings schema as a bare object with no properties, so `imagePayloadThreshold`, `imageTokenEstimate`, `maxRecentFilesToRetain`, `maxRecentImagesToRetain`, `enableScreenshotTrigger` and `screenshotTriggerThreshold` were invisible to settings help, validation and the IDE schema. They are now declared with the defaults and bounds the runtime resolvers already enforce, and the generated IDE JSON schema is regenerated from them. The settings reference documents the eviction threshold and the image token estimate, which were previously undocumented.

## Why it's needed

Fixes #15495. A vision workflow that needs every frame in history had no supported way to stop eviction: the threshold accepted only integers >= 1, and setting a very large number was an undocumented workaround. Undeclared settings also meant the knobs never surfaced in help or validation.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `npm -w packages/core run build`
2. `npx vitest run packages/core/src/services/compactionInputSlimming.test.ts packages/core/src/core/llm-chat.test.ts` — 761 tests pass, including two new ones: the resolver accepts `0`, and a session with three inline images keeps all three in both the durable history and the later request when the threshold is `0`.
3. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/config/` — 2167 tests pass, including a new assertion that every `model.chatCompression` knob is declared with its runtime bound.
4. `npx prettier --check` and `eslint --max-warnings 0` on the touched files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non-UI change (config + schema + docs), so N/A. The new `llm-chat` test fails when the `imagePayloadThreshold > 0` guard is removed, which is the regression this pins.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local `npm run build` for `packages/core` plus vitest unit runs; no sandbox or live model endpoint involved.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: `0` is a new accepted value for a knob whose previous minimum was `1`. A user who set `0` before got the default `20` silently; they now get eviction disabled. That reading matches every other "count of items to keep" knob in the same settings block, where `0` means "none", so the behavior is consistent rather than surprising.
- Not validated / out of scope: the request-only rewrite (not mutating stored history at all, rewriting only the outgoing copy) is the third part of #15495 and needs its own design discussion; it is untouched here. The full `npm run build` and the repo-wide suite were not run. `npm -w packages/cli run typecheck` reports 24 errors, in files this PR does not touch and which reproduce identically on `origin/main` at `6fb74164`.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The new schema properties are additive, and the runtime validation was already the source of truth.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15495

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

让图片载荷驱逐（image payload eviction）可以关闭，并把运行时早已读取的 `model.chatCompression` 设置正式声明出来。

驱逐阈值现在接受 `0`，表示"永不把图片载荷从历史里改写掉"。为 `0` 时整个驱逐流程被跳过，因此存储的历史和发出去的请求都保留全部内联图片。

`model.chatCompression` 之前只声明为一个没有 properties 的空对象，导致 `imagePayloadThreshold`、`imageTokenEstimate`、`maxRecentFilesToRetain`、`maxRecentImagesToRetain`、`enableScreenshotTrigger`、`screenshotTriggerThreshold` 在设置帮助、校验和 IDE schema 里都不可见。现在按运行时解析函数已有的默认值和边界声明它们，并据此重新生成 IDE 的 JSON schema。设置参考文档补上了此前没写的驱逐阈值和图片 token 估算。

## 为什么需要

修复 #15495。需要历史里保留每一帧的视觉工作流，此前没有任何受支持的办法阻止驱逐：阈值只接受 >= 1 的整数，设一个很大的数只是没有文档的变通做法。未声明的设置也意味着这些开关从不出现在帮助或校验里。

## 审阅者验证步骤

1. `npm -w packages/core run build`
2. `npx vitest run packages/core/src/services/compactionInputSlimming.test.ts packages/core/src/core/llm-chat.test.ts` —— 761 个测试通过，其中两个是新增的：解析函数接受 `0`；阈值为 `0` 时，含三张内联图片的会话在持久历史和后续请求里都保留这三张。
3. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/config/` —— 2167 个测试通过，其中新增一条断言：`model.chatCompression` 的每个开关都按运行时边界声明。
4. 对改动文件跑 `npx prettier --check` 和 `eslint --max-warnings 0`。

### 证据

纯配置 / schema / 文档改动，无 UI，N/A。新增的 `llm-chat` 测试在移除 `imagePayloadThreshold > 0` 守卫后会失败，这正是它固定的回归点。

### 测试平台

macOS 已测；Windows、Linux 未测。

### 环境

本地构建 `packages/core` 加 vitest 单测；不涉及沙箱或真实模型端点。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：`0` 是这个开关新的可接受值，之前最小是 `1`。此前把 `0` 写进配置的用户会静默拿到默认值 `20`，现在会真的关闭驱逐。这与同一设置块里其他"保留多少个"的开关（`0` 表示不保留）的读法一致，因此是统一而非意外。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：#15495 的第三部分——不再改写存储历史、只改写发出的副本——需要单独的设计讨论，本 PR 未涉及。未跑完整 `npm run build` 和全仓测试。`npm -w packages/cli run typecheck` 报 24 个错误，都在本 PR 未触及的文件里，且在 `origin/main`（`6fb74164`）上完全一致地复现。
- 破坏性变更：无。新增的 schema 属性是追加式的，运行时校验本来就是唯一真相来源。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): reply to SDK initialize only after config is ready
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The SDK `initialize` control response is now sent after config initialization finishes, not right after the request is handled. The initialize request is still handled first, so its SDK MCP servers and staged SDK-only config are in place before extensions load. If config initialization fails, the request receives an error response instead of no reply at all.

In protocol terms, the frame's meaning changes from "request accepted" to "SDK mode is ready": a client may treat a successful `initialize` reply as permission to send its first prompt.

The deferred reply is bounded. `initializeSdkMode` derives its deadline from the client's own `timeout.controlRequest` (`sdkInitializeReplyTimeoutMs`, minus up to 5 s, halved for declared budgets below 10 s, and 55 s when none is declared), so `initialize` has three outcomes: a success frame once initialization finishes, an error frame carrying the initialization failure, and a success frame when the deadline passes first. The third case keeps the reply inside the client's budget without closing the query: both shipped clients treat an error reply as fatal, and initialization keeps running, readiness settles when it does, and prompts queued behind it are still served. The frame is informational; every prompt is still gated on `awaitConfigInitialized`.

## Why it's needed

`initialize` was answered before `config.initialize()` ran, so the reply only meant "request accepted". A client that sent its first prompt on that reply then blocked on readiness; when the shared extension store was locked by another process, it waited out the ~28s retry budget and surfaced "Extension store is busy". Making the reply wait for config initialization turns it into the readiness signal clients already assume it is, and gives initialization failures a place to be reported.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Use the controlled repro from the issue: hold the `extension-store/lock` and start a stream-json SDK session.
2. Send `initialize`, then one user frame.
Before: `initialize` replies while the lock is still held, and the first prompt later fails with "Extension store is busy". After: the `initialize` reply arrives only once config initialization has completed, so a prompt sent after it no longer races extension loading. Release the lock before the initialize retry budget (~28 s) runs out, otherwise the initialize request receives the "Extension store is busy" error frame. If initialization fails for any other reason, the same request gets that error response.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non-UI change, so N/A for screenshots. `replies to initialize only after config initialization finishes` fails on the previous ordering (reply sent while initialization is pending) and passes here; `replies to initialize with an error when SDK mode initialization fails` covers the new failure reply. Existing dispatch behaviour is unchanged and covered by `ControlDispatcher` tests, including the deferred failure path: with `deferResponse` the dispatcher must send nothing and leave the reply to the caller.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Unit tests on macOS and in a `node:22-bookworm` container; Windows not exercised.

### Environment (optional)

`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/nonInteractive/control/ControlDispatcher.test.ts src/nonInteractive/session.test.ts` (106 tests: 65 + 41).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the initialize reply now includes config initialization latency, so clients that pipelined work on the old "accepted" ack see a later reply. That is the intended protocol meaning of the frame.
- The reply is bounded by the client's `timeout.controlRequest`: a client with a tight budget gets the deferred success frame before initialization finishes, so `initialize` keeps its "accepted, and the session is becoming ready" meaning rather than becoming a hard readiness gate. Measured on this branch with a declared 20 s budget and 22 s initialization, the frame arrived at ~16 s and the queued turn then started.
- Not validated / out of scope: the read path still takes the exclusive extension-store lock; concurrent sessions sharing one config dir can still serialize. Only the readiness ordering is changed here.
- Known pre-existing limitation, stated because the reply is now a readiness signal: duplicate `initialize` request ids. `registerIncomingRequest` overwrites the entry by id and a cancel answers only one frame, so the earlier caller waits out the SDK timeout. The registry behaviour is unchanged by this PR.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Closes #15796

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

SDK 的 `initialize` 控制应答现在在配置初始化完成之后才发送，而不是在请求被处理后立刻发送。初始化请求仍然最先被处理，因此它的 SDK MCP server 和暂存的 SDK 专用配置会在扩展加载前就位。如果配置初始化失败，该请求会收到错误应答，而不是完全收不到应答。

用协议语言说，这一帧的含义从「请求已接受」变成了「SDK 模式已就绪」：客户端可以把成功的 `initialize` 应答当作可以发送第一条 prompt 的许可。

这个延迟应答是有上限的。`initializeSdkMode` 的截止时间取自客户端自己声明的 `timeout.controlRequest`（`sdkInitializeReplyTimeoutMs`，最多减去 5 秒，声明的预算低于 10 秒时按一半扣；客户端未声明时为 55 秒），因此 `initialize` 有三种结果：初始化完成后的成功帧、携带初始化失败原因的错误帧，以及截止时间先到时返回的成功帧。第三种情况下初始化仍在继续，就绪状态会在其完成后落地，排在后面的 prompt 仍会被处理；该帧是信息性的 ack，不表示已就绪。

## 为什么需要

`initialize` 原先在 `config.initialize()` 运行之前就被应答，因此该应答只意味着「请求已接受」。据此发送第一条 prompt 的客户端随后会阻塞在就绪等待上；当共享的扩展存储在另一个进程中被占用时，它会等满约 28 秒的重试预算，然后抛出 "Extension store is busy"。让应答等待配置初始化，就把这个应答变成了客户端本就默认它具备的就绪信号，并且给初始化失败提供了上报位置。

## 审阅者验证方式

### 如何验证

1. 使用 issue 中的受控复现：占住 `extension-store/lock`，然后启动一个 stream-json SDK 会话。
2. 发送 `initialize`，然后发送一个用户帧。

修改前：`initialize` 在锁仍被占用时就应答，第一条 prompt 随后以 "Extension store is busy" 失败。修改后：`initialize` 应答只在配置初始化完成后到达，因此在其后发送的 prompt 不再与扩展加载竞争。请在 initialize 重试预算（约 28 秒）耗尽前释放锁，否则该 initialize 请求会收到 "Extension store is busy" 错误帧。如果初始化因其他原因失败，同一个请求会收到对应的错误应答。

### 证据（修改前后）

非 UI 改动，截图不适用。`replies to initialize only after config initialization finishes` 在旧时序下失败（初始化仍未完成时就已应答），在本分支下通过；`replies to initialize with an error when SDK mode initialization fails` 覆盖了新的失败应答。既有的分发行为未变，由 `ControlDispatcher` 测试覆盖，包括延迟失败路径：使用 `deferResponse` 时分发器必须不发送任何内容，把应答留给调用方。

### 测试环境

|    操作系统    | 状态 |
| :------------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS      |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows     |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux      |  ✅  |

单元测试在 macOS 与 `node:22-bookworm` 容器中运行；未在 Windows 上验证。

### 环境（可选）

`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/nonInteractive/control/ControlDispatcher.test.ts src/nonInteractive/session.test.ts`（106 项测试：65 + 41）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：initialize 应答现在包含了配置初始化的耗时，因此按旧的「已接受」确认来流水线推进工作的客户端会看到更晚的应答。这正是该帧在协议上应有的含义。
- 应答受客户端 `timeout.controlRequest` 约束：声明了紧凑预算的客户端会在初始化完成前收到成功帧（信息性 ack，不关闭会话），会话在初始化完成后继续可用。在本分支上以 20 秒预算、22 秒初始化实测，该帧在约 16 秒时到达，排队的那个 turn 随后正常开始。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：读取路径仍会获取扩展存储的排他锁；共享同一配置目录的并发会话仍可能串行化。本次只改变就绪时序。
- 已知的既有局限（因为应答现在就是就绪信号，此处特别说明）：重复的 `initialize` 请求 id。`registerIncomingRequest` 按 id 覆盖条目，而取消只应答一帧，因此较早的调用方会等满 SDK 超时。该注册表行为不由本 PR 改变。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 issue

Closes #15796

</details>

prs.title: fix(channels): stop resending a GitHub reply after an ambiguous answer
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes the restart-retry pass for pending GitHub replies treat an ambiguous delivery answer as consumed, so a reply GitHub may already have posted is not sent a second time. The ambiguous audit row now records which pending record it decided, and the resend guard reads that.

## Why it's needed

At channel start, `retryPendingFinalDeliveries()` re-sends replies stored in the pending-delivery file. When GitHub answers a re-send ambiguously (a 502, a timeout — the write may have landed), the pass audits `failed_ambiguous` and then removes the record so it is never sent again.

That removal can fail — ENOSPC, EACCES, a failed rename — and the record then survives to the next start. The guard that should stop the second send, `hasPostedPublicationAudit()`, only recognised a `posted` row carrying that `pendingId`, and the `failed_ambiguous` row carried none. So on the next start the record was sent again, and a thread whose first comment had actually landed received a second public reply.

Fixes #16394.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The regression test drives two consecutive retry passes. The first one answers the comment call ambiguously and leaves the pending file unparseable, so the record survives; the second pass starts with that record still on disk.

Without the change, `createComment` is called twice across the two passes (the duplicate this issue reports). With the change, it is called once — the second pass finds the `failed_ambiguous` audit for that `pendingId`, drops the record, and sends nothing.

### Evidence (Before & After)

```
# without the fix (source reverted, new test kept):
AssertionError: expected "spy" to be called 1 times, but got 2 times
 Tests  1 failed | 521 skipped (522)

# with the fix:
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  522 passed (522)
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Unit tests only; macOS is the only platform I ran them on. The code path is platform-independent.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an ambiguous answer is now sticky for that pending record even if GitHub provably never created the comment. That is the same at-most-once contract the source-key guard already applies to `failed_ambiguous`, so the two idempotency paths now agree instead of disagreeing. The cost of being wrong is a reply that is never retried; the cost of the old behaviour was a duplicate public comment.
- Not validated / out of scope: I did not exercise a real failed rewrite (ENOSPC/EACCES) against a live GitHub endpoint; the test simulates it by making the pending file unparseable, the same way the neighbouring test does. The broader rework suggested in the issue — converging this pass on `readPublicationAuditKeys()` — is deliberately not part of this change: that guard resolves "last outcome per source key wins", and a later definite `failed` row re-opens a key, so moving onto it needs its own correctness argument for records retried across restarts.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Existing audit rows without a `pendingId` keep their current meaning.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16394

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

让 GitHub 待发回复的重启重发流程把「歧义」的投递答复视为已消费，从而不会把 GitHub 可能已经发出的回复再发一次。歧义审计行现在会记录它判定的是哪条待发记录，重发守卫据此读取。

## 为什么需要

channel 启动时，`retryPendingFinalDeliveries()` 会重发待发文件里保存的回复。当 GitHub 对重发给出歧义答复（502、超时——写操作可能已经成功）时，这一轮会记一条 `failed_ambiguous` 审计，随后删除该记录，保证不再重发。

但删除可能失败——ENOSPC、EACCES、rename 失败——记录于是留到了下次启动。本该拦住第二次发送的 `hasPostedPublicationAudit()` 只认携带该 `pendingId` 的 `posted` 行，而 `failed_ambiguous` 行不带 `pendingId`。于是下次启动会再次发送，第一次评论其实已经落地的线程就收到了第二条公开回复。

修复 #16394。

## 审查测试计划

### 如何验证

回归测试连续驱动两轮重发。第一轮让评论调用返回歧义、并让待发文件不可解析，记录因此存活；第二轮开始时该记录仍在磁盘上。

没有本改动时，两轮合计 `createComment` 被调用两次（即本 issue 报告的重复）。有本改动时只调用一次——第二轮发现该 `pendingId` 的 `failed_ambiguous` 审计，删除记录，不再发送。

### 证据（改动前后）

```
# 撤掉修复、保留新测试：
AssertionError: expected "spy" to be called 1 times, but got 2 times
 Tests  1 failed | 521 skipped (522)

# 加上修复：
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  522 passed (522)
```

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

仅单元测试；我只在 macOS 上跑过。该代码路径与平台无关。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：对某条待发记录而言，歧义答复现在变成粘性的，即使 GitHub 确实没建出评论。这与 source-key 守卫对 `failed_ambiguous` 已采用的至多一次契约一致，因此两条幂等路径从互相矛盾变为一致。判错的代价是一条回复不再重试；旧行为的代价是多出一条公开评论。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：我没有对真实 GitHub 端点制造真实的写入失败（ENOSPC/EACCES）；测试通过把待发文件变为不可解析来模拟，与相邻测试手法相同。issue 中建议的更大幅度重构——让本轮改用 `readPublicationAuditKeys()`——有意没有包含在本改动中：该守卫按「同一 source key 最后一条 outcome 胜出」，之后一条确定性的 `failed` 会重新打开该 key，跨重启重发的记录要用它需要单独的正确性论证。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。没有 `pendingId` 的历史审计行语义不变。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): keep tool-result markdown when the result fits its height budget
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Stops demoting a tool result to plain text just because the message carries a terminal-height budget. The plain-text fallback in `ToolMessage` exists to bound a result that is too tall for the space it has, because that path runs through `MaxSizedBox`; it was also firing for results that fit the budget whole, which cost them their formatting for no height reason. The decision is now made on the result's rendered height, measured with the same rendered-height estimator `MarkdownDisplay` pre-slices with, so the markdown branch and the fallback agree about what "fits".

Shell output keeps the plain-text path whenever its output is on screen, because the `ui.shellOutputMaxLines` cap renders and counts its hidden lines through `MaxSizedBox` and the ANSI path draws the `ShellStatsBar` overflow count. `ShellTool` itself declares its output as not markdown, so that branch now only pins the reason instead of relying on the height budget to imply it.

## Why it's needed

In the interactive CLI, a completed `ask_user_question` answer summary shows `**Color**: Blue` instead of a bold label. Every tool result two lines tall lost its markdown the moment a height budget was present, which is the normal state for a message in a 100x24 terminal — long before anything actually needed truncating. The issue's own note puts it the same way: "ToolMessage disables Markdown whenever a terminal-height budget is present, even for short results."

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Ask `ask_user_question` a question, answer it, and look at the completed tool result: it should show a bold **Color** label rather than the literal `**` markers. A result taller than the budget still falls back to plain text and still shows the "... first N lines hidden ..." marker, and shell output is still capped and still reports its hidden-line count.

The new tests in `ToolMessage.test.tsx` cover all three shapes: a short result renders through the markdown renderer under a 20-row budget, a 40-line result under the same budget does not, and shell output under the same budget stays on the plain-text path.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Not captured as a screenshot: this worktree cannot build the CLI bundle (see Environment), so the change is verified by component tests rather than a tmux capture. Before the change, the first new test fails (the result renders as plain text); after it, all 105 tests in the file pass.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

`npx vitest run src/ui/components/messages/ToolMessage.test.tsx` from `packages/cli`, with the package's `globalSetup` prerequisite guard stubbed out (the worktree has no built `acp-bridge` / `web-templates` / channel `dist/`). No runtime was launched.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: any non-shell tool whose output is long enough to overflow its budget now renders as plain text on the same rule as before, but the boundary is a rendered-height estimate rather than "any budget at all". A result just under the estimate keeps markdown and relies on `MarkdownDisplay`'s own slice, which uses the identical estimator, so the two can only disagree if the estimator itself is wrong for a block the renderer measures differently (tables and code fences are the two cases the estimator already handles specially).
- Not validated / out of scope: no interactive run; Windows and Linux untested. The full `npm run build` does not complete in this worktree, so typechecking was limited to `packages/cli` (`npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` reports no error in either changed file; the 10 errors it prints are unresolved `@qwen-code/acp-bridge/*` subpaths that this worktree cannot build).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13956

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

不再因为消息带终端高度预算就把工具结果降级成纯文本。`ToolMessage` 里的纯文本回退是为了把**过高**的结果限制在可用空间内（那条路径走 `MaxSizedBox`），但它也会对整段放得下的结果生效，让它们白白丢掉格式。现在改为按结果的**渲染高度**决定，用的估算函数和 `MarkdownDisplay` 预裁剪时所用的是同一个，因此 markdown 分支和回退分支对"是否放得下"的判断一致。

Shell 输出只要显示就会继续走纯文本路径，因为 `ui.shellOutputMaxLines` 上限的隐藏行是通过 `MaxSizedBox` 渲染和计数的，ANSI 路径负责画 `ShellStatsBar` 的溢出计数。`ShellTool` 本身就声明输出不是 markdown，所以这个分支现在只是把原因写明，而不是靠"有高度预算"来隐含它。

## 为什么需要

在交互式 CLI 中，已完成的 `ask_user_question` 答案摘要显示的是 `**Color**: Blue` 而不是加粗标签。任何两行高的工具结果只要存在高度预算就会丢掉 markdown，而在 100x24 终端里这是消息的常态——远早于真的需要截断。issue 自己的描述也是这样写的："ToolMessage disables Markdown whenever a terminal-height budget is present, even for short results."

## Reviewer 验证方式

调用 `ask_user_question` 提一个问题并作答，然后看已完成的工具结果：应当显示加粗的 **Color** 标签，而不是字面的 `**`。超过预算的结果仍会回退成纯文本并显示 "... first N lines hidden ..." 标记；shell 输出仍会被截断并报告隐藏行数。

`ToolMessage.test.tsx` 里新增的三条用例覆盖了这三种情况：短结果在 20 行预算下走 markdown 渲染；同样预算下 40 行结果不走；shell 输出在同样预算下留在纯文本路径。

### 证据（改动前后）

没有截图：这个 worktree 无法构建 CLI bundle（见 Environment 一节），所以本次改动通过组件测试验证，而不是 tmux 录屏。改动前，新增的第一条用例会失败（结果被渲染成纯文本）；改动后，该文件 105 条测试全部通过。

### 测试环境

在 `packages/cli` 下执行 `npx vitest run src/ui/components/messages/ToolMessage.test.tsx`，并把该包的 `globalSetup` 前置条件检查打桩（worktree 里没有构建好的 `acp-bridge` / `web-templates` / 各 channel 的 `dist/`）。没有启动实际运行时。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：任何非 shell 工具的输出，只要超过预算，仍然和以前一样会变成纯文本，但边界从"只要有预算"变成了一个渲染高度估算。刚好在估算之下的结果会保留 markdown 并依赖 `MarkdownDisplay` 自身的裁剪，而它用的是同一个估算函数，所以两者只可能在渲染器对某个块的度量与估算不一致时出现分歧（表格和代码围栏是估算函数已特殊处理的两类）。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：没有做交互式运行；Windows 和 Linux 未测试。这个 worktree 里完整 `npm run build` 跑不完，所以类型检查只覆盖了 `packages/cli`（`npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` 对两个改动文件均无报错；它输出的 10 条错误都是本 worktree 无法构建的 `@qwen-code/acp-bridge/*` 子路径）。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #13956

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): commit only the selected files from the commit view
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The Web Shell commit view can now commit a subset of the dirty files. It lists every uncommitted file with a checkbox, preselects all of them, and sends the selection with the commit. Unchecked files stay in the working tree, and work the user had already staged outside the selection stays staged instead of being swept in.

Underneath, the shared commit helper and the daemon commit route gained a `paths` option next to the existing `all` flag. The dialog sends an explicit selection whenever the listing is complete; a click while the first listing is still in flight is refused with a "list is still loading" message instead of committing the whole tree, and a listing the daemon capped commits everything, which the legend says.

Renames are handled explicitly: either half of a rename selects the pair, because git only records the rename when the deletion and the addition land in the same commit.

## Why it's needed

The commit view always committed everything. A single session that produced two unrelated changes (a bug fix and a refactor, say) could only be split into clean commits from a terminal, which defeats the point of having the dialog. The issue asks for per-file checkboxes so the Web Shell git workflow matches what the CLI already allows.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Unit and route tests cover the new behavior; no manual UI session was run. Reproduce the original gap by opening the commit view with two dirty files and pressing Commit — before this change both files are in the commit, after it only the checked ones are, and unchecking all of them surfaces a "select at least one file" error instead of a daemon call.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no screenshot or recording was captured for this run.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Tests and lint run locally on macOS from a linked worktree; no `npm run dev` session.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the dialog now depends on the diff listing to build a selection. A listing the daemon caps or cannot produce falls back to committing every change (``all: true``), which the dialog discloses in its legend; only the not-yet-loaded state is refused, so a slow diff route delays a commit from the dialog but a broken one does not block it (the CLI is unaffected).
- Not validated / out of scope: no manual UI verification on a running daemon, and no full `npm run build`. `packages/cli` typecheck was not run (fresh worktree reports unrelated TS6305 on unbuilt workspace dependencies); `packages/core` typecheck passes. `packages/web-shell` typecheck reports only the 12 known stale-SDK errors, which are identical on `origin/main`.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `all: true` keeps its previous semantics.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #8446

prs.title: fix(core): create session transcripts with owner-only permissions
prs.body:
## What this changes

Session transcripts (`<session>.jsonl`) persist tool output verbatim and can embed credentials, but were created world-readable: `ensureConversationFile()` called `fs.writeFileSync(..., { flag: 'wx', encoding: 'utf8' })` without a mode, so Node applied `0o666 & ~umask` (0644 under the common 022 umask), and the append path in `jsonl-utils` recreated a missing file the same way.

- `jsonl-utils`' `writeLine` / `writeLineSync` pass `0o600` at their four creation points, so a transcript deleted mid-session is recreated owner-only on the next append (the documented recovery path) instead of falling back to umask.
- Legacy transcript appends now go through a dedicated fd-bound writer (`legacy-session-transcript-writer.ts`): no-follow open, regular-file/identity/owner-evidence verification on one fd (fail closed), `fchmod` clearing only group/other while preserving owner bits (a 0400 transcript is never made writable), and the append itself through the pinned descriptor. Symlink/FIFO/directory paths, unverifiable identities, and Managed/conflicting owner records are refused instead of followed.
- `ChatRecordingService.ensureConversationFile()` keeps creation of a missing transcript under the session archive write fence, now with `0600`; ownership verification and permission tightening happen on the verified append fd.
- Ownership evidence is a bounded, tri-state read (`true` = positive Managed evidence found; `false` = none found within the bound, which releases a failed Managed activation's lease; `undefined` = unverifiable, which keeps it held), and `activateChatRecording` refuses Legacy- or unverifiable-owned transcripts before the lease is taken.
- The writer classifies each boundary line structurally: a provably unfinished user message no longer stops recording, while owner-shaped, duplicate-key and undecidable lines fail closed; records too large to verify are refused before they reach the file; and the boundary-line read is chunked so appends to a large transcript cost one 64 KiB chunk.
- A Managed acquisition refuses to take over a schema-2 Legacy handoff seal instead of retiring it; a certified Legacy successor can still take over.

Secret redaction in the write path (the other half of #18165) is intentionally out of scope to keep this change atomic.

Applies to the default legacy writer path. The lease/managed writer (`sessionWriterLeaseEnabled`, non-default) already creates transcripts with `0o600` and writes under its own fencing; its transcript fingerprint includes the file mode, which is why legacy tightening never touches Managed-owned transcripts. Generic `jsonl.writeLine`/`writeLineSync` keep the `0o600` creation mode for their own callers (usage history, workflow journal, etc.).

## Why

Refs #18165 — discussed with @qqqys there; write-time redaction and cleanup of existing logs remain open on that issue. Reviewed by @wenshao (first round) and @qqqys (four rounds, each verified against a real filesystem); every round's findings and fixes are documented in the PR thread, with regression tests.

## How to verify

- `pnpm --filter @qwen-code/core test src/services/chatRecordingService.test.ts src/services/chatRecordingService.permissions.test.ts src/services/session-legacy-execution-refusal.test.ts src/utils/jsonl-utils.test.ts src/config/managed-session-log.test.ts src/utils/sessionStorageUtils.test.ts src/services/session-writer-lease.test.ts src/services/session-execution-engine.test.ts` — 742 passed, 2 skipped.
- `chatRecordingService.permissions.test.ts` drives a real temp dir (no fs mocks) and covers: owner-only creation, tightening a world-readable file, preserving an owner-read-only mode, Managed transcripts untouched, symlink refusal (target sentinel unchanged), symlink installed after the fd is opened (TOCTOU), FIFO/directory refusal without blocking, owner-record version/conflict fail-closed, recreate-after-delete, the pinned-descriptor append when the path is unlinked, torn user messages (missing outer brace, truncated text, literal and escaped markers, recorder subtypes), glued owner/ordinary records, the 32 MiB verification bound (EOF and newline), duplicate/reordered owner fields, a per-append I/O budget assertion, and a seeded property fuzz over generated transcripts asserting soundness, liveness, byte-exact no-corruption and repeatability. POSIX mode assertions are skipped on Windows (`describe.skipIf`).
- `utils/jsonl-utils.test.ts` covers the generic writer's own post-probe deletion race (async and sync variants).
- `config/managed-session-log.test.ts` covers the lease-acquisition race (glued v1/v2 owner lines) and schema-2 seal preservation; `utils/sessionStorageUtils.test.ts` covers the evidence-reader contract (glued/torn/escaped shapes, read failures).
- ESLint / Prettier / `tsc --noEmit` clean on the touched files.

## Scope

- `packages/core/src/utils/jsonl-utils.ts` (0600 creation mode, generic callers)
- `packages/core/src/services/legacy-session-transcript-writer.ts` (new, fd-bound legacy writer with structural line classification)
- `packages/core/src/services/chatRecordingService.ts` (route legacy appends through the new writer)
- `packages/core/src/utils/sessionStorageUtils.ts` (fd-based, tri-state owner evidence reader)
- `packages/core/src/services/session-writer-lease.ts` (schema-2 seal guard for Managed acquisition)
- `packages/core/src/services/session-execution-engine.ts` (export the ownership accumulator)
- `packages/core/src/services/chatRecordingService.test.ts` / `chatRecordingService.permissions.test.ts` / `session-legacy-execution-refusal.test.ts` / `config/managed-session-log.test.ts` / `utils/sessionStorageUtils.test.ts` / `services/session-writer-lease.test.ts` (tests)

prs.title: feat(verify-pr): add destructive-diff adversarial protocol, top-level review capture, and mechanical publish guard
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR hardens the pull-request verification workflow across three layers so silent data-loss bugs, mid-round maintainer reviews, and stale or moved heads cannot slip through a green verdict:

- **Diff-triggered adversarial verification protocol and independent recovery oracle**: Whenever a pull request modifies exclusion, ignore, skip, cleanup, pruning, snapshot, or migration logic, the verification instructions now require naming the core safety invariant, reserving an adversarial falsification budget even on follow-up rounds, checking real in-repo writers into excluded paths, and sweeping six explicit axes (path indirection and reverse dependencies such as symlinked external object stores, placement and nesting depth, ignore-rule spelling variants with mixed layouts and complexity ladders, real upper caller entry points across at least two consecutive sweeps, combinatorial control-flow interactions, and anti-over-refusal controls). Snapshot, backup, cleanup, and pruning changes must be verified after real destruction and external maintenance by an independent consumer reading history that cannot be reconstructed from the working tree rather than trusting the system's own verification return value, and suggested fixes must be adversarially tested against at least one counterexample.
- **Maintainer top-level blocking comments captured in review state**: Both the local preparation step and the CI triage workflow now fetch the latest 100 top-level pull-request comments alongside inline review threads and standing change requests, filtering down to non-minimized comments from owners, members, and collaborators while recording the total comment count to disclose truncation. Non-bot top-level maintainer reviews marked Critical, Blocker, P0, or P1 carry the same open-blocking budget and merge-ready bar as inline blocking review threads, while untrusted commenter prose stays out of the token-free sandbox.
- **Mechanical pre-publish guard gate**: The pre-publish guard now timestamps snapshots, blocks self-comparison through symlink or hardlink aliases, and writes a structured, SHA-256-bound host verdict record on both clean and dirty comparisons so a stale clean result cannot survive a later dirty check. The artifact checker can now mechanically enforce that host verdict before local publication—verifying schema, clean status, PR coordinates and verified head against the trusted host context snapshot, open PR state at both ends, monotonic and valid calendar UTC timestamps, capture freshness, host-only file boundaries, and refusal of any verdict planted inside the PR-writable artifact directory.

## Why it's needed

Across five verification rounds on #18494, the existing verification workflow reliably caught build breaks and weak test assertions, yet repeatedly missed severe regressions that parallel manual reviews reproduced on the same commits: silent loss of tracked files and nested worktree drafts, in-repo review worktrees inside ignored cache paths, quadratic directory scans under wildcard ignore rules, duplicate archive accumulation across consecutive cleanup sweeps, over-refusal of standalone external repositories, and external Git object directories symlinked back into ignored cache paths. In addition, maintainer reviews posted as top-level comments with P1 findings were invisible to the review-thread snapshot, and because the pre-publish guard was only a convention rather than a mechanical check, Round 4 published eight minutes after a new top-level P1 on the same head and Round 5 certified merge-ready twenty-three minutes after two new P1s and eighteen minutes after the head had already moved.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Confirm that review-state preparation captures non-minimized top-level comments from owners, members, and collaborators alongside the total comment count, excludes minimized and non-maintainer comments, fails closed on malformed comment payloads, and stays strictly identical between the local helper and the CI workflow filter.
2. Confirm that running the pre-publish guard comparison with an output verdict writes a structured record and prints a matching digest on clean rounds, refuses self-comparison across symlinks or hardlinks as well as unsafe output paths, and overwrites any previous clean verdict with a dirty verdict when a new comment, edit, state change, or push arrives.
3. Confirm that running the artifact checker with guard enforcement accepts a fresh clean host verdict bound to the trusted host context, and fails closed when the guard verdict is missing, unbound by digest, unbound by host context, dirty, stale (anchored on capture time rather than only comparison time), non-open, mismatched in PR coordinates or head, linked or placed inside the PR-writable tree, or planted inside the artifact directory.
4. Confirm that the updated verification skill rules pass the repository's shell AST allowlist audit (including hostile mutation checks on the new guard and checker invocations) and that the workflow definition passes static workflow linting.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before vs. After live behavior proof for top-level maintainer review capture and the mechanical pre-publish guard gate:

![Before vs After live behavior proof for top-level maintainer blocking comments and mechanical pre-publish guard gate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/verify-pr-adversarial-and-guard-gates/assets/verify-pr-adversarial-and-guard-gates/01-ab-guard-and-review-state.png)

Local verification gates (unit/CLI suites, ESLint, Prettier, and actionlint):

![Local verification gates passing for guard, check, ESLint, Prettier, and actionlint](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/verify-pr-adversarial-and-guard-gates/assets/verify-pr-adversarial-and-guard-gates/02-verification-gates.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux (Node.js local worktree): live GitHub GraphQL pagination query verified against #18494, 7 affected Vitest suites (712 passed, 5 skipped, 0 failed), ESLint (0 errors), Prettier (all matched files clean), actionlint (0 errors), and isolated sparse-checkout execution test confirming the artifact checker runs without the guard helper present.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Top-level comment snapshotting uses the latest 100 comments to avoid interfering with thread cursor pagination, so very long threads disclose truncation via the total comment count; freshness enforcement assumes host clock skew stays within 60 seconds between snapshot capture and publication check.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS and Windows runners were not executed locally (Windows-only symlink/POSIX skips will be verified by CI), and prompt-level adherence to the six adversarial axes relies on agents following the explicit coverage/not-covered reporting contract.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. Guard enforcement is opt-in via the strict requirement flag for local publication, existing snapshots without capture timestamps remain accepted by the snapshot validator, and CI publish-lane sparse checkouts remain self-contained.
- Design documentation: [English](docs/design/2026-11-27-verify-pr-adversarial-and-guard-gates.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-11-27-verify-pr-adversarial-and-guard-gates.zh-CN.md)

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本 PR 从三个层面加固了 PR 验证工作流，避免静默数据丢失缺陷、验证途中新落地的维护者复审评论以及过期或已移动的提交再次在绿灯判定下漏过：

- **由 diff 触发的对抗验证协议与独立恢复验收准则**：只要 PR 改动了排除、忽略、跳过、清理、修剪、快照或迁移逻辑，验证规范即要求先写明核心安全不变量、在后续跟进轮次同样保留对抗破防预算、盘点仓内往被排除目录写入数据的真实消费者，并系统扫描六条对抗轴（路径间接性与外部反向依赖如外置对象目录软链回被删目录、位置与嵌套深度、忽略规则拼写变体/混合布局/复杂度阶梯、真实上层调用入口的连续至少两轮稳态收敛、控制流早标组合交互、以及抗过度拒绝的可用性对照）。快照、备份、清理与修剪类改动必须在真实销毁并执行外部维护动作后，由独立消费者读取无法从工作区重建的历史状态来验收，不得信任被测系统自带的校验返回值；验证者给出的建议修复同样须针对其新增判别前提做至少一个反例反打。
- **将维护者顶层阻塞评论纳入评审状态快照**：本地准备阶段与 CI 分类工作流同步拉取最新 100 条顶层 PR 评论及评论总数，与行内评审线程和现有变更请求一并写入评审快照；仅保留仓库所有者、成员与协作者的非折叠评论，避免外部非协作者正文进入无令牌验证沙箱。排除验证报告自身及机器人生命周期评论后，带 Critical、Blocker、P0 或 P1 标记的维护者顶层复审享有与行内阻塞线程同等的预算和 merge-ready 门槛，超过 100 条时在未覆盖项中披露截断。
- **发布前守卫升级为机械化硬门禁**：发布前守卫现在会记录快照抓拍时间戳、通过真实路径与文件标识拦截软硬链接自我对比，并在 clean 与 dirty 两种结果下均覆写结构化宿主裁决文件并输出摘要绑定，避免旧的 clean 结果在后续 dirty 复检中残留。产物检查器现可在本地发布前机械校验该宿主裁决：核验结构版本、clean 状态、与可信宿主上下文绑定的 PR 坐标及已验证提交、起止 PR 状态均为 OPEN、单调且符合真实日历的 UTC 时间戳、抓拍鲜度窗口、宿主路径信任边界，并始终拒绝私自植入在 PR 可写产物目录内的裁决文件。

## 为什么需要它

在 #18494 的五轮验证中，原有验证流程稳定抓出了编译失败与空转断言，却在相同提交上连续漏检了并行人工复审复现的多类严重回归：已跟踪文件与嵌套工作树草稿静默丢失、被忽略缓存目录中的仓内评审工作树、通配忽略规则触发的平方级目录扫描、连续清理轮次的重复归档堆积、独立外置仓库被过度拒绝，以及外置 Git 对象库软链回被忽略缓存目录导致历史损坏。同时，维护者以普通顶层评论发出的 P1 复审在评审线程快照中完全不可见；而发布前守卫仅靠口头约定而非机械检查，导致第 4 轮在同提交落下新顶层 P1 评论 8 分钟后仍发布报告，第 5 轮在落下两条新 P1 后 23 分钟且分支已推送新提交 18 分钟后仍给出了 merge-ready。

## 评审者测试计划

### 验证步骤

1. 确认评审状态准备能够抓取所有者、成员与协作者的非折叠顶层评论及评论总数，过滤已折叠评论与外部非协作者评论，对畸形评论结构 fail-closed，且本地脚本与 CI 工作流过滤结果严格一致。
2. 确认带输出路径运行发布前守卫比对时，干净轮次写入结构化裁决并打印匹配摘要，通过软硬链接自我对比或不安全输出路径均被拒绝，且新评论、编辑、状态变化或新提交到达时会把原路径上的旧 clean 裁决覆写为 dirty。
3. 确认开启守卫强校验运行产物检查器时，新鲜干净且与可信宿主上下文一致的宿主裁决可通过；而缺裁决、缺摘要、缺宿主上下文、dirty、抓拍过期（锚定抓拍时间而非仅比对时间）、PR 非 OPEN、坐标或提交不匹配、路径落在 PR 可写树内或软硬链接、以及产物目录内私自植入裁决文件均被 fail-closed 拦截。
4. 确认更新后的验证规范通过仓库的 shell AST 白名单审计（含对新增守卫与检查调用的对抗变异校验），且工作流文件通过静态语法校验。

### 证据（改前与改后）

顶层维护者阻塞评论抓取与机械化发布前守卫门禁的改前/改后实测对照：

![顶层维护者阻塞评论抓取与发布前守卫硬门禁改前改后实测对照](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/verify-pr-adversarial-and-guard-gates/assets/verify-pr-adversarial-and-guard-gates/01-ab-guard-and-review-state.png)

本地验证门禁实测输出（单元与 CLI 套件、ESLint、Prettier 与 actionlint）：

![本地验证门禁通过截图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/verify-pr-adversarial-and-guard-gates/assets/verify-pr-adversarial-and-guard-gates/02-verification-gates.png)

### 已测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### 环境（可选）

Linux（Node.js 本地 worktree）：已对 #18494 实测真实 GitHub GraphQL 分页查询，7 组受影响 Vitest 套件全部通过（712 passed、5 skipped、0 failed），ESLint 0 错误，Prettier 全部匹配文件通过，actionlint 0 错误，并在隔离稀疏签出目录中实测产物检查器无需守卫脚本即可独立运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险与权衡：顶层评论快照抓取最近 100 条以保持评审线程游标分页稳定，超长 PR 会通过评论总数披露截断；鲜度校验假定宿主机在抓拍与检查间的时钟偏差不超过 60 秒。

auto_merge.commit_message:
* feat(verify-pr): add destructive-diff adversarial protocol, top-level review capture, and mechanical publish guard

Close three systemic verification blind spots exposed across five rounds on PR #18494:
- Add a diff-triggered adversarial falsification protocol (6 mandatory axes), an independent post-destruction recovery oracle, and suggested-fix counterexample self-attack to the /verify-pr skill.
- Extend the GraphQL review-state snapshot and CI workflow parity filter to capture non-minimized top-level comments from OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR reviewers (last 100 plus totalCount) under the same merge-ready bar as open blocking review threads.
- Turn the pre-publish guard into a mechanical fail-closed gate with capture timestamps, symlink/hardlink alias refusal, digest-bound host verdict records (--out), freshness checks, coordinate/head/OPEN enforcement, and planted-file refusal.

* fix(verify-pr): harden guard refresh retries, VM publish check, and review-state parity

Address review feedback on 6e5f54cd75 and follow-up adversarial audit findings:
- P1: Clear stale guard-now/verdict files and refresh guard-now.json inside the same local publish step (exiting immediately on failure); also make verify-pr-guard.mjs --snapshot remove any stale regular snapshot on fetch failure while refusing to touch symlinks, hardlinks, or non-regular files.
- P2: Document and verify the runner-backed VM publish command (microvm/provider-vm) carrying --execution-record, --execution-record-sha256, and the vault artifact directory alongside --require-guard in the same verify-pr-check.mjs invocation.
- P3: Reject arrays (e.g. [[]]) and array-typed nested nullable objects symmetrically in local reviewState() and the CI workflow jq filter, with shared malformed-page parity tests.
- Audit hardening: Require --context-sha256 binding under --require-guard, reject inverted snapshot timestamps in compareSnapshots(), tighten repo slug validation, and reject empty flag values or stray positional arguments in verify-pr-guard.mjs.

* fix(verify-pr): isolate per-round guard snapshots, recheck head after pagination, and invalidate on write failure

Address all findings from review 7231584332 and verify report 7231736737 (R2-F1, R2-F2, R2-F3, S1) plus follow-up audit hardening:
- R2-F1 & S1 [P1]: Isolate start snapshot, final snapshot, verdict, log, and digest inside a per-round host directory (~/.cache/qwen-verify/pr<n>/<round-id>/) used from round start through publication; add an explicit round-start capture step with --no-clobber (O_EXCL) so concurrent local rounds on the same PR cannot overwrite each other's guard-start.json.
- R2-F2 [P1]: Re-read PR head and state after all paginated comment fetches finish in verify-pr-guard.mjs fetchSnapshot() and fail closed if either changed while pages were in flight, validating both metadata responses as plain objects.
- R2-F3 [P3]: Invalidate any stale regular snapshot or verdict file on write failure (such as EACCES on a read-only file in a writable directory) without touching symlinks, hardlinks, non-regular files, or --no-clobber targets.

* fix(verify-pr): close guard-before-prepare window, recheck reviews/comments, isolate guard dir from container mount, and reject null confirmations

Address all four findings from review 7232570584 plus follow-up audit hardening:
- P1 (prepare vs guard-start gap): Require allocating an independent <round-id> and creating guard-start.json (--no-clobber) before verify-pr-prepare.mjs fetches review-threads.json (or re-running prepare afterward), documented in both container step 1 and the publish guard section.
- P1 (mid-fetch CHANGES_REQUESTED / review comments): Re-read formal reviews and inline reviewComments alongside head and PR state after all paginated fetches complete in verify-pr-guard.mjs fetchSnapshot(), using canonical id-sorted comparison so any change during pagination fails closed.
- P2 (container mount isolation): Move per-round guard directories out of the Docker-mounted ~/.cache/qwen-verify/pr<n> (/verify-context) tree to ~/.cache/qwen-verify-guard/pr<n>/<round-id>/, and pin the separation with negative AST checks.
- P3 (closing null confirmation & malformed list entries): Return explicit { ok, value } results from call() so a closing JSON null response never skips head/state/list verification, and validate every list element as a plain object before normalization.

* fix(verify-pr): move single lightweight GraphQL closing probe after all paginated fetches

Address P1 review 7232891531 on 8de61decc0:
- Move the closing confirmation in verify-pr-guard.mjs fetchSnapshot() strictly AFTER both pagination passes (reviews + reviewComments re-checks) and upgrade it to a single non-paginated GraphQL probe (GUARD_CONFIRM_QUERY) checking headRefOid, state, formal review count/latest review (databaseId, state, submittedAt), and top-level comment count/latest comment (databaseId, updatedAt) atomically, failing closed on GraphQL errors, JSON null, or malformed summaries.
- Fast-fail initial isSnapshot() validation before running confirmation calls.
- Document cleanup of legacy guard files under qwen-verify/pr<n>/ on upgraded workstations and add end-to-end publish-chain regressions for pushes and new top-level P1 comments landing during the second reviews pass.

* fix(verify-pr): detect in-place edits of earlier comments and reviews in closing GraphQL probe

Address P1 review 7233208383 and verify report 7233433128 (A1/A2/B1/B2) on 4d9a9829e2 (following merge of origin/main 5d9ba8b02b for lint gate freshness):
- Add `latestEditedComment: comments(first: 1, orderBy: { field: UPDATED_AT, direction: DESC }) { nodes { databaseId updatedAt body } }` to GUARD_CONFIRM_QUERY and verify id, updatedAt, normalized body, and max updatedAt (handling same-second ties and CRLF/LF normalization without false positives).
- Upgrade `reviews(last: 1)` to `reviews(last: 100) { totalCount nodes { databaseId state submittedAt body } }` in GUARD_CONFIRM_QUERY so state changes or dismissals on earlier reviews (B1) and body-only edits on the latest review (B2) during the final pagination pass are caught atomically.
- Add full publish-chain regression tests for in-place editing of earlier comment #71, earlier review #60 state change, and latest review #61 body-only edit.

* fix(verify-pr): paginate >100 formal reviews in closing probe and add incremental ?since= probes for review and issue comments

prs.title: feat(core): copy .worktreeinclude paths into new worktrees
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds support for a repository-level `.worktreeinclude` file: a committed, gitignore-syntax list of ignored paths that are copied from your main checkout into every worktree the CLI creates.

A `git worktree add` checkout contains only tracked files, so gitignored local state — `.env`, `appsettings.Development.json`, local certificates — is absent. This PR reads `.worktreeinclude` at the repository root (one pattern per line, `#` comments, blank lines skipped), matches those patterns against git's own ignored set, and copies the matches into the new checkout while preserving directory structure.

Patterns are only ever matched against `git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard`, never expanded from disk. That keeps tracked files, `.git` internals and paths outside the repository unreachable by construction: the worst a committed pattern can do is select a file git already lists as ignored. The listing is recursive, so a pattern naming a fully-ignored directory selects the files inside it rather than a directory entry that can't be copied.

The copy runs on both creation paths — `createUserWorktree` (the `--worktree` flag, the `enter_worktree` tool, and `agent` worktree isolation) and `setupWorktrees` (Agent Arena) — so one committed file covers every worktree family. It is non-fatal throughout: a missing or unreadable file, an oversized one, or an individual copy failure leaves the worktree usable without those files. The file is capped at 1 MB and 10,000 patterns because it is committed input that anyone with push access can change, and each pattern costs time against every ignored file.

## Why it's needed

Agents working in a worktree routinely need local, never-committed files — an API key in `.env`, a machine-specific dev config — and today every new worktree requires manual setup or a custom provisioning script. Running several isolated agents in parallel multiplies that cost. This is the last unimplemented item from the worktree design's advanced list (the `.worktreeinclude` row in `docs/design/worktree.md`), and it is tracked as #10584.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

In a scratch repository that ignores `.env` and `.local/`:

1. Create `.env`, `.local/top.txt` and `.local/sub/deep.txt` in the main checkout, plus a `.worktreeinclude` containing `.env` and `.local/`.
2. Create a worktree (`qwen --worktree=one`, or `createUserWorktree('one', 'main')` directly).
3. The new checkout contains all three files with the source contents; a gitignored path not named in the file (try `secrets/*.json`) is absent.
4. Delete `.worktreeinclude` and create another worktree: nothing is copied and the worktree still succeeds.

The new integration test file pins those four outcomes plus a negation (`!config/example.json`), a tracked file named by a pattern (not copied twice / not selected at all), the size cap, and a `.worktreeinclude` that is a directory.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: `packages/core/src/services/gitWorktreeService.ts` copied only untracked files in `setupWorktrees`; `createUserWorktree` copied nothing. After: both paths copy the resolved `.worktreeinclude` set.

```
$ cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/services/gitWorktreeService.worktreeinclude.integ.test.ts \
    src/services/gitWorktreeService.test.ts src/services/gitWorktreeService.symlinks.integ.test.ts
 ✓ ... (13 tests) / (41 tests) / (15 tests)
 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  69 passed (69)
```

`npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json` and `npx eslint` on the touched files pass.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS only. Windows and Linux not run locally; the copy path is plain `fs` with repository-relative paths from git, and CI covers the rest.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit and integration tests only (real `git` against temp repos).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a committed `.worktreeinclude` lets anyone with push access decide which ignored files a clone copies into its worktrees. The blast radius is bounded to gitignored files that already exist in the source checkout, but a pattern reaching a large ignored tree (a build cache) would copy it per worktree with no size limit. That tradeoff is documented in the user docs' Limitations section.
- Not validated / out of scope: symlinks among the ignored files are copied as whatever `fs.copyFile` does with them (the link target's contents), not recreated as links. Worktrees created before a line is added do not retroactively receive the file.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Without a `.worktreeinclude`, behaviour is unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #10584

prs.title: feat(core,cli): support OpenAI Responses multimodal/dialects and auto-select Chat Completions audio encoding
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR adds native multimodal input and tool-result handling, lightweight wire dialect descriptors, plaintext reasoning replay, SSE framing hardening, and environment-variable ergonomics to the OpenAI Responses API path, and fixes Chat Completions audio input encoding so it automatically adapts between DashScope Data URI format and standard OpenAI / OpenAI-compatible raw base64 without adding new user-facing settings.

On the OpenAI Responses API path, it introduces immutable capability descriptors to distinguish strict OpenAI Responses endpoints from DashScope-compatible Responses endpoints while keeping the request/response converter free of vendor-name conditionals. It adds support for image, audio, and video inline and file-URI inputs, promotes tool-returned audio and video (and custom-tool images) to a trailing `user` message with clear attachment notes, enforces presence-as-true `InputModalities` gating with actionable disabled-modality placeholders distinct from unsupported-MIME notices, gates `oss://` URIs and audio formats by dialect capability, and tightens the Responses wire DTO types. It also unifies Responses reasoning signature parsing, adds dialect-gated plaintext reasoning replay alongside encrypted reasoning, preserves plaintext reasoning when only summary deltas streamed, handles SSE comment lines and CRLF framing, strips Chat Completions `thinking_budget`, downgrades `tool_choice: 'required'` to `'auto'` when active thinking is enabled on DashScope Qwen models, allows `OPENAI_WIRE_API=responses` without requiring `OPENAI_BASE_URL`, and adds `QWEN_MODEL` fallback alongside `OPENAI_MODEL` for `USE_OPENAI_RESPONSES`.

On the Chat Completions path, it automatically sends `data:<mime>;base64,...` Data URIs for DashScope-compatible endpoints and Qwen OAuth while sending raw base64 without a Data URI prefix for standard OpenAI and non-DashScope OpenAI-compatible servers (such as SGLang), with an internal provider-level override hook and shared MIME normalization across image, video, and audio payloads.

## Why it's needed

Previously, the OpenAI Responses API converter dropped audio and video inputs and did not support DashScope-compatible Responses wire conventions (such as `input_audio` Data URIs / `audio_url`, `input_video`, `oss://` resource resolution headers, plaintext reasoning replay, or SSE comment/CRLF framing). Meanwhile, configuring Responses via `OPENAI_WIRE_API=responses` failed when `OPENAI_BASE_URL` was omitted or when users specified `QWEN_MODEL` as documented in `docs/users/configuration/auth.md`. On Chat Completions, unconditionally sending Data URI prefixes in `input_audio.data` broke standard OpenAI and SGLang servers that expect raw base64.

These changes share the same media-MIME normalization utilities, wire-capability patterns, and DashScope provider detection, and over half of the diff consists of focused unit and regression tests, so they are grouped into a single independent OpenAI protocol PR.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run TypeScript typechecking for both `@qwen-code/qwen-code-core` and `@qwen-code/qwen-code`:

```bash
npx tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit
npx tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit
```

2. Run all affected core and CLI unit test suites:

```bash
npx vitest run \
  packages/core/src/utils/media-mime.test.ts \
  packages/core/src/utils/thoughtUtils.test.ts \
  packages/core/src/core/openaiResponsesContentGenerator/responses-dialect.test.ts \
  packages/core/src/core/openaiResponsesContentGenerator/responses-converter.test.ts \
  packages/core/src/core/openaiResponsesContentGenerator/responses-pipeline.test.ts \
  packages/core/src/core/openaiResponsesContentGenerator/prompt-caching.test.ts \
  packages/core/src/core/openaiContentGenerator/converter.test.ts \
  packages/core/src/core/openaiContentGenerator/pipeline.test.ts \
  packages/core/src/core/openaiContentGenerator/provider/dashscope.test.ts \
  packages/core/src/models/modelConfigResolver.test.ts \
  packages/core/src/omni/upload-config.test.ts \
  packages/core/src/core/llm-chat.test.ts

(cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/utils/modelConfigUtils.test.ts)
```

3. Verify lint and formatting checks pass cleanly (`npm run lint` / `prettier --check`).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-facing TUI/UI change. All 12 core suites (`2,157 / 2,157` tests, including `llm-chat.test.ts`) and CLI `modelConfigUtils.test.ts` (`81 / 81` tests) passed locally, with `0` TypeScript errors across core and CLI and clean `eslint --max-warnings 0` / `prettier --check`.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.x local unit tests (`vitest`, `tsc`, `eslint`, `prettier`).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Endpoint dialect selection for Responses API and Chat Completions audio encoding delegates to the existing `DashScopeOpenAICompatibleProvider.isDashScopeProvider()` check (narrowed to `Pick<ContentGeneratorConfig, 'authType' | 'baseUrl'>`), ensuring zero non-standard fields or headers are ever sent to `api.openai.com` or unknown third-party endpoints. Custom OpenAI-compatible gateways that require DashScope Responses behavior can set `DASHSCOPE_PROXY_BASE_URL` or use the internal provider override on Chat Completions.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows and Linux native CI runs (covered by GitHub Actions CI on this PR); Gemini / Vertex transport and multimodal tool-output changes are kept separate in the companion PR (`feat/gemini-multimodal-transport-compat`), which shares the exact byte-for-byte identical `packages/core/src/utils/media-mime.ts` and `media-mime.test.ts` files so either PR can merge first cleanly without conflict.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. No new public configuration keys are introduced; `docs/users/configuration/auth.md` is updated to document `OPENAI_WIRE_API=responses` with optional `OPENAI_BASE_URL`.

## Linked Issues

N/A (independent companion to the Gemini transport & native multimodal tool-outputs PR).

prs.title: fix(core): name the model and setting in media refusals
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a model cannot accept an image, audio, or video file, Qwen Code refuses it with a message the model then reads. That message named neither the model nor the setting behind the refusal, and it read identically whether the input modalities were guessed from the model name or declared by the user. In both cases it ended by pointing at skills, which is the wrong direction when the real cause is a configuration value.

The refusal now leads with the model id and states how the modalities were resolved. A value inferred from the model name tells the caller to declare `generationConfig.modalities` on the provider entry. A value the user declared points at where it was declared instead. The rest of the guidance — that `read_file` cannot process the file either, and the skills fallback — is unchanged, as is the separate PDF wording that suggests installing the document-skills extension.

## Why it's needed

Reported in #16178. A provider-backed model with image input configured was refused, and the message sent the reporter down a resize-image path; the setting had been right all along and the resolved route genuinely had no image modality. The message was accurate about the state but not actionable, because the one fact that would have separated "you configured this wrong" from "we guessed wrong from the name" was already computed and then discarded.

The resolved configuration already tracks where each field came from, so the distinction costs no new resolution logic. The source kind is carried on the request context for the API-time path; the read_file path reads it directly. It is deliberately withheld when the generator is serving a model other than the configuration's primary one, so a sub-agent or side query cannot inherit the primary model's attribution and report a setting the user never set for it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Configure an OpenAI-compatible provider entry whose model id matches no known family pattern, without `generationConfig.modalities`, then ask the agent to read a PNG. The refusal should name that model id and say the modalities were inferred from the model name, with the exact JSON key to add.

Then add `"modalities": { "image": true }` to that entry and repeat: the image is read instead of refused, which confirms the advice points at the field that actually decides the outcome.

A model whose id does match a known vision pattern, with image modality left on, should still read images normally — the new text only replaces a refusal.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before and after are the text the model receives. Captured from the real read_file path and the real request-building pipeline, with a 1x1 PNG on disk and modalities resolving empty:

Before (both cases identical):

```
[Unsupported image file: "image.png". This model does not support image input. The read_file tool cannot process this type of file either. ...]
```

After, modalities guessed from the model name:

```
[Unsupported image file: "image.png". Model 'my-custom-openai-id' does not support image input: its input modalities were inferred from the model name. Declare "generationConfig": { "modalities": { "image": true } } on this provider entry to enable it. The read_file tool cannot process this type of file either. ...]
```

After, modalities declared on the provider entry without image:

```
[Unsupported image file: "image.png". Model 'my-custom-openai-id' does not support image input: this provider entry's "generationConfig.modalities" is set without image. Check it and re-select the model with /model. The read_file tool cannot process this type of file either. ...]
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Unit tests, type checking, lint, and formatting were all run inside a `node:22-bookworm` Linux container against the merged base. The macOS column is ⚠️ rather than ✅: the same suite also passes there, but the bundle build needed for the full CLI integration harness does not complete on this machine's container filesystem, so the end-to-end evidence above was produced from the source-level pipeline rather than a bundled CLI run. Nothing in this change is platform-specific.

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests and type checking in a Linux container; no sandbox, no live model endpoint.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the refusal text is what the model reads, so changed wording can shift model behaviour around file handling. The leading clause keeps the substring previous assertions and any model familiarity rely on, and the advice is additive.
- Not validated / out of scope: the reporter's original observation that the setting appeared to need a restart is not addressed here. The modalities are re-resolved on auth refresh and on `/model`, so the hint says "re-select the model with /model" rather than claiming a restart is required; whether their hot-reload path was misbehaving is a separate question left open on the issue.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The new request-context field is optional and nothing else reads the message text.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16178


<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

当某个模型无法接受图片、音频或视频文件时，Qwen Code 会拒绝它，并给出一条由模型读取的说明。这条说明既没有点名模型，也没有指出拒绝背后的设置，而且无论输入模态是从模型名推断出来的、还是用户显式声明的，读起来都一模一样。两种情况下它还都以指向 skills 收尾，而当真正的原因是某个配置值时，这个方向是错的。

现在这条拒绝信息以模型 id 开头，并说明模态是如何解析出来的。从模型名推断出的值会提示调用方在 provider 条目上声明 `generationConfig.modalities`；用户显式声明的值则改为指出它声明在哪里。其余指引——`read_file` 同样无法处理该文件，以及 skills 兜底——保持不变；PDF 的单独措辞（建议安装 document-skills 扩展）也不变。

## 为什么需要

见 #16178。一个配置了图片输入的 provider 模型被拒绝，而这条信息把报告者引向了一条「压缩图片」的路径；其实那个设置一直是对的，解析出的路由确实没有图片模态。这条信息对状态的描述是准确的，但不可操作，因为那个本可以区分「你配置错了」和「我们从名字猜错了」的关键事实早已被算出，却又被丢弃了。

解析后的配置本就记录了每个字段来自哪里，因此这个区分不需要新的解析逻辑。来源种类会随请求上下文带到 API 时路径上；read_file 路径则直接读取它。当生成器服务的不是配置中的主模型时，它会刻意被 withhold，这样某个子代理或侧查询就不会继承主模型的归因，去报告一个用户从没为它设过的设置。

## 审阅者验证方式

### 如何验证

配置一个 OpenAI 兼容的 provider 条目，其模型 id 不匹配任何已知的家族模式，且不写 `generationConfig.modalities`，然后让代理读取一个 PNG。拒绝信息应当点名该模型 id，说明模态是从模型名推断的，并给出要添加的确切 JSON 键。

接着给该条目加上 `"modalities": { "image": true }` 再重复一次：图片会被读取而不是被拒绝，这就确认了提示指向的是真正决定结果的字段。

一个 id 确实匹配已知视觉模式的模型，在图态保持开启时，应当仍然正常读取图片——新文案只替换拒绝信息。

### 证据（修改前后）

修改前后指的都是模型收到的文本。取自真实的 read_file 路径与真实的请求构建流水线，磁盘上放一张 1x1 的 PNG，模态解析为空：

修改前（两种情况完全相同）：

```
[Unsupported image file: "image.png". This model does not support image input. The read_file tool cannot process this type of file either. ...]
```

修改后，模态从模型名推断：

```
[Unsupported image file: "image.png". Model 'my-custom-openai-id' does not support image input: its input modalities were inferred from the model name. Declare "generationConfig": { "modalities": { "image": true } } on this provider entry to enable it. The read_file tool cannot process this type of file either. ...]
```

修改后，provider 条目声明了模态但不含图片：

```
[Unsupported image file: "image.png". Model 'my-custom-openai-id' does not support image input: this provider entry's "generationConfig.modalities" is set without image. Check it and re-select the model with /model. The read_file tool cannot process this type of file either. ...]
```

### 测试环境

|    操作系统    | 状态 |
| :------------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS      |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows     |  N/A |
|  🐧 Linux      |  ✅  |

单元测试、类型检查、lint 与格式化都在 `node:22-bookworm` Linux 容器中对合并后的基线运行。macOS 一栏是 ⚠️ 而非 ✅：同一套测试在该平台也通过，但完整 CLI 集成测试所需的 bundle 构建在本机的容器文件系统上无法完成，因此上面的端到端证据来自源码级流水线，而不是打包后的 CLI 运行。本改动没有任何平台相关的部分。

### 环境（可选）

Linux 容器中的单元测试与类型检查；无 sandbox，无真实模型端点。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：拒绝文案是模型读取的内容，措辞变化可能影响模型在文件处理上的行为。开头子句保留了既有断言和模型熟悉度所依赖的子串，新增建议是追加式的。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：报告者最初的观察——该设置似乎需要重启——没有在本 PR 中处理。模态会在鉴权刷新与 `/model` 时重新解析，因此提示说的是「用 /model 重新选择模型」，而不是声称需要重启；他们的热重载路径是否异常是另一个问题，留在 issue 中。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。新增的请求上下文字段是可选的，也没有其他地方读取消息文本。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #16178

</details>

prs.title: fix(agents): keep A2A tasks recoverable after transcript read errors
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Session-based A2A requests return the existing retryable JSON-RPC error `-32012` when a filesystem error prevents reply lookup in an active or archived transcript. The failing observation saves no task result. Once reads recover, the same task can report `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` with its original reply.

## Why it's needed

A transient read error could make a recorded reply appear absent and cause a completed task to be permanently saved as `TASK_STATE_FAILED`. A permissions check can still succeed when the actual read fails. The linked issue reproduces this with injected `EIO`. [Issue #13738](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13738), [earlier proposal and review](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13797).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

From `packages/cli`, run `npx --no-install vitest run --coverage.enabled=false src/serve/routes/a2a.test.ts -t 'after an EIO'`. The regression cases inject a stream read failure in each transcript location. Check that `GetTask`, `ListTasks`, `CancelTask`, and a replay of `SendMessage` return `-32012` with no internal path details and no saved task result. After restoring the stream, poll the same task with `GetTask` and check that it returns and saves `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` with the original reply. The cases also check the oversized archive and unexpected-error paths.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The local JSON-RPC daemon probe used the same recorded-reply fixtures for both versions. On installed Qwen Code 0.27.3, polling under `EIO` returned and saved `TASK_STATE_FAILED` for both transcript locations. Polling after recovery returned the same state. In the fixed bundle, polling under the same fault returned `-32012` and the task mappings contained no result. The next poll returned and saved `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` with the original reply. Healthy, missing-transcript, and mismatched-reply controls produced the expected results on both versions.

Build, bundle, typecheck, focused ESLint and Prettier checks, and the focused CLI and core suites passed. The suites ran 22 CLI tests and 391 core tests.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status        |
| :--------: | :------------ |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested     |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS 27.0 arm64 and Node 22.18.0 for the fixed bundle. The probe used a local `serve` daemon with experimental agent collaboration enabled and synthetic on-disk fixtures.

## Risk & Scope

- An unreadable active transcript takes precedence over the archived copy because the archive may hold a stale reply. The session loaders use strict reads by opt-in, with A2A as the sole caller that enables them.
- Previously saved failures, malformed reply records, and concurrent archive restoration are outside the fix. The existing cancellation decision and receipt behavior still depend on observing the task.
- The fix uses the existing task schema, storage format, and JSON-RPC code. It requires no data migration.

[Design document (Simplified Chinese)](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/350a7e3f7a3850d4f8bdb3b8b3784c897f832537/docs/design/managed-agents/a2a-transcript-read-recovery.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13738

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

基于会话的 A2A 请求在活动或归档 transcript 因文件系统错误而无法查找回复时，返回现有的可重试 JSON-RPC 错误 `-32012`。本次失败的观测不会保存任务结果。读取恢复后，同一个任务可以返回 `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` 和原回复。

## Why it's needed

瞬时读取错误可能让已记录的回复看起来缺失，导致已经完成的任务被永久保存为 `TASK_STATE_FAILED`。即使实际读取失败，权限检查仍可能通过。关联 issue 使用注入的 `EIO` 复现了这个问题。[Issue #13738](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13738)、[早期方案及评审](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13797)。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

在 `packages/cli` 运行 `npx --no-install vitest run --coverage.enabled=false src/serve/routes/a2a.test.ts -t 'after an EIO'`。回归用例分别在两处 transcript 注入流读取故障。确认 `GetTask`、`ListTasks`、`CancelTask` 和同请求重发的 `SendMessage` 返回 `-32012`，响应不包含内部路径，任务也没有保存结果。恢复读取后，通过 `GetTask` 查询同一个任务，确认返回并保存 `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` 和原回复。用例也检查归档超出大小限制和未预期错误的处理路径。

### Evidence (Before & After)

本地 JSON-RPC daemon 探针对两个版本使用了相同的已记录回复 fixture。使用已安装的 Qwen Code 0.27.3 时，两处 transcript 在 `EIO` 期间的查询都返回并保存 `TASK_STATE_FAILED`。读取恢复后查询仍返回相同状态。使用修复后的 bundle，在相同故障下查询返回 `-32012`，任务映射没有保存结果。下一次查询返回并保存了 `TASK_STATE_COMPLETED` 和原回复。正常 transcript、文件缺失以及回复属于其他 run 的对照在两个版本上均符合预期。

构建、打包、类型检查、定向 ESLint 与 Prettier 检查，以及 CLI 和 core 定向测试均通过。两套测试分别运行了 22 项和 391 项。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status        |
| :--------: | :------------ |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested     |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

修复后的 bundle 使用 macOS 27.0 arm64 和 Node 22.18.0。探针在启用实验性 Agent 协作的本地 `serve` daemon 中运行，使用合成的磁盘 fixture。

## Risk & Scope

- 活动 transcript 无法读取时优先报告该故障，因为归档副本里的回复可能已过时。加载器以显式启用的方式使用严格读取，只有 A2A 调用方启用。
- 之前已保存的失败、损坏的回复记录和并发归档还原超出本次修复范围。现有的取消决策和回执仍依赖于观测任务。
- 修复沿用现有任务数据结构、存储格式和 JSON-RPC 错误码，无需数据迁移。

[中文设计文档](https://github.com/water-in-stone/qwen-code/blob/350a7e3f7a3850d4f8bdb3b8b3784c897f832537/docs/design/managed-agents/a2a-transcript-read-recovery.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

#13738

</details>
